I'm a pediatrician. I’m pissed. I’m scared. And I need your help to defeat Lindsey Graham in the U.S. Senate.
I’m not the “monsters-under-the-bed” kind of scared. I’m the “I’ve watched children suffer from preventable illness and injury while politicians do absolutely nothing” kind of scared.
I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.
But I’m scared. I’m pissed. I’m motivated. And I’m 100% in.
I’m running for Senate in South Carolina to defeat Lindsey Graham and to fight for the kids no one in D.C. seems to be thinking about. So I need you with me.
We need to hit 10,000 donations before midnight to prove that this campaign can go the distance. Can I count on you to split a donation with my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
I’m running because the Republican Party, led by people like Lindsey Graham, is dismantling the very systems that keep our kids safe here in South Carolina.
I’m running because the issues I care about — children’s healthcare, vaccines, gun violence, public education, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare — are under direct attack right now.
And I’m running because I consider it my professional duty as a pediatrician — to give children a strong voice at the national level. Too many are comfortable on the sidelines. That won’t work for me.
We need bold leaders who aren’t afraid to fight. I am ready.
Even though the path will be hard, I know Lindsey Graham must be held accountable. He certainly doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.
That’s why I’m running for US Senate. To defeat Trump’s lapdog and fight for everyday Americans. But, I need your support today. Dr. Annie Andrews

name: Lauren Underwood
subject: Black Maternal Health Week 2026
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Janelle Bynum for Congress
body:
During Black Maternal Health Week, help us finish the job and pass the legislation that will finally close this deadly gap.

Friend, The United States has the worst maternal mortality rate in the entire developed world — and it's getting worse. For Black mothers, the crisis is even more stark: **Black women are three times as likely as white women to die from pregnancy-related complications.** That is not a statistic we should accept. That's why, in 2019, I co-founded the Black Maternal Health Caucus with a straightforward mission: _save moms' lives._ I have spent every year since fighting to pass the **Momnibus** — the most comprehensive maternal health legislation in our nation's history. We are making real progress. Since 2023, the Black Maternal Health Caucus has secured over $200 million in new Momnibus funding through the federal appropriations process — and that money is now flowing directly to community organizations, researchers, providers, and families across the country. This March, I was proud to reintroduce the Momnibus alongside Rep. Alma Adams and Senator Cory Booker — all 14 bills that comprehensively address every driver of maternal mortality, morbidity, and racial disparities in this country. The _Protecting Moms Who Served Act_ is already law. Now we must finish the work and pass the rest. **80% of maternal deaths in America are preventable.** The tools to stop them exist. Congress must act — and the urgency has never been greater. _**[As a registered nurse, I know firsthand the need to end this crisis, and I will never stop working to save moms’ lives. ### **Senator Angela Alsobrooks Endorses Kevin Ford, Jr. for Maryland State Senate in District 24**
---
| | [](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69e0ffef4ff32f25c3d35a06&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fendorsedbyalsobrooks&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69e0d9cf69296a567d1a6932&l=en-US&s=cV9vXXR_GoBsRDDi6Bq_5xFl4uc%3D) |
---|---|---
#### **Prince George’s County, MD —** U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks today endorsed Kevin Ford, Jr. in his campaign for Maryland State Senate in District 24, adding significant statewide support to a campaign that has been building strong momentum across the district.
#### “I’ve had the opportunity to watch Kevin Ford, Jr. grow into a strong and thoughtful leader whose north star has always been his commitment to serve. Kevin is rooted in this community, unafraid to stand up for what’s right, and focused on delivering real results. District 24 needs steady, results-driven leadership—and Kevin Ford, Jr. is that leader. I’m proud to stand with him.”
#### Ford, a lifelong Prince George’s County resident, small business owner, and community mentor, has built his campaign around a clear commitment to families — focusing on delivering results, expanding opportunity, and ensuring every community in District 24 has a voice in Annapolis.
#### Since launching his campaign, Ford has built a growing grassroots coalition across District 24, earning support from residents, community leaders, and local advocates who believe in responsive, people-centered leadership.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202023%20fundraising%20email%20banner.png]
Peter,
Congress is voting TODAY on whether hundreds of thousands of Haitian families get to live, work, and stay together – or are pushed back into danger.
They are considering H.R. 1689 [https://secure.everyaction.com/neTd2a8HHUmPXBFFLI1FXg2] , a bill to extend TPS (Temporary Protective Status) to 350,000 of our Haitian friends and neighbors.

body:
Instead of taking action to save lives and prevent disastrous wildfires, the Trump administration is stripping funding. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129585948/614858091/-272948131?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260417_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGZmOWQ1Mi1hZDM5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-u3u2UwyS7NrMS5dS_yt80XnhS853aX_cgdN7zpmxm8=&emci=50746ea9-a839-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=14ff9d52-ad39-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=252045)
---
Folks, Just when I think they can’t do more harm to our public lands, this administration doubles down — closing regional Forest Service offices and cutting funding for fire management _right before fire season._ This is unacceptable. In December, knowing this administration would keep shortchanging our public lands, I urged Senate appropriators to fund wildfire recovery and ramp up prescribed burns, fuel treatments, and other prevention work to protect New Mexico’s lands and communities for future generations. In New Mexico, so much of who we are is where we live and the lands we call home. Our lands have been in families for generations, and our ranches and farms are both a way of life and essential livelihoods. [_**New Mexicans deserve better from this administration. My name is Mustafa, and I’m proud to be Saikat’s Digital Director. Most political campaigns are carefully managed from the top down. Consultants and party insiders decide what the candidate says, when they say it, and how that message gets delivered to voters. We do things a little differently here. I’ve been lucky enough to tag along with Saikat to nearly every event since we launched this campaign – which means I’ve captured the intimate moments that separate Saikat from run-of-the-mill corporate Democrats. No polish. No handlers. Just Saikat – knocking doors in the Sunset, hosting town halls in Bayview, meeting voters at Dolores Park, and occasionally freestyling with the team. From day one, Saikat has refused to take a dime for corporate PACs or lobbyists. That means we don’t answer to big donors or party insiders – and it means we have nothing to hide. I hope you enjoy these videos – and if you do, be sure to share them with your friends! The establishment has big money. We have people – and the truth. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. [ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Most people will skim this email or skip it entirely.

But if you’re reading this, you’re exactly who we need right
now.

Because the truth is, this race for governor is already taking shape —
even if most people aren’t paying attention yet.

Michigan is a battleground. National Republicans have made it a top
target. And the DeVos family has already poured $5 million into supporting
our opponent.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b957786b-e73e-4af4-ba96-1535519af1e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's a number that should bother you: **only 4 -5% of retirement accounts ever reach $1 million.**
Yet financial advisors keep telling people they need _**two or three times that**_ to retire comfortably.
That math doesn't work. And **deep down, most investors know it.**
So what if the problem isn't how much you've saved -- but _how your account is designed to work for you_?
For 20+ years, I've been teaching everyday investors a different approach. Not "buy and hope." Not chasing the next hot stock. A structured framework built around one idea:
**Income. Every week. Regardless of what the market does.**
It takes about 30 minutes on a Friday. Works with smaller accounts. And once you learn it -- it's a skill you carry for life.
Inside this free guidebook, you'll discover:
* Why waiting for "someday" growth is the riskiest retirement strategy of all
* How weekly options can generate income in up markets, down markets, and sideways markets
* The simple 3-step structure thousands of everyday investors use to pursue $1,000-$5,000 per month
* Why you don't need to predict anything -- just follow the rules

**The market doesn 't owe you a retirement.**
But the right structure might just build you one.
[Grab the Free Guidebook](https://substack.com/redirect/b957786b-e73e-4af4-ba96-1535519af1e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
For years, the SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) and the CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission) have been fighting over who gets to regulate crypto. The SEC treated almost everything as a security. The CFTC argued many tokens were "commodities" once they became sufficiently decentralized. The result was absolute chaos.
* Companies didn't know which rules to follow.
* Innovation moved offshore.
* Investors were left in the dark.
* **The CLARITY Act ends that turf war.**

It creates a new category called "digital commodities" -- basically any digital asset whose value comes from the blockchain network itself rather than from the promises of a central company would fall under the CFTC's oversight. Assets that still look like traditional investment contracts (where people buy in hoping a team will deliver future profits) stay under the SEC. The bill also includes important protections for decentralized finance developers and validators, giving them safe harbors so they aren't treated like illegal securities dealers just for helping run a network.
**Why does this matter so much?**
Because the United States is in a global race to lead in the next generation of technology. Digital assets and blockchain are not just speculative toys -- they are infrastructure now. The days of being just "fake internet money" are long since over. Blockchains underpin everything from stablecoins used in everyday payments to tokenization of real-world assets like real estate and bonds. Without clear rules, America risks watching the entire industry move to friendlier jurisdictions while we argue in courtrooms.

clean_body: We're making a major investment in 2026. | = Peter, We’re reaching out with an important reminder: earlier this year, EMILYs List launched our 2026 State Power Plan — a $15 million strategy to secure governing majorities across nine key states by recruiting, investing in, and supporting Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot. Here’s why this matters so much right now: states are one of the most important checks on Trump and the Republican chaos coming out of Washington. State leaders decide whether extremists can gerrymander themselves into permanent power, whether health care gets slashed, whether voting rights are protected, and whether abortion protections can be defended and restored. That’s why EMILYs List is going all-in in Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin — and continuing to engage in other state races where Democrats can put a major check on Republican extremism. But launching a plan is only the beginning. To execute it, we need the full strength of this community. ******=**** | = EMILYs List has helped elect over 2,300 women to state and local office, and we’ve seen what happens when we build power from the ground up: stronger protections, better policies, and real veto power against extremist agendas. Now the stakes are higher — and the margins are tighter. In some of these states, control of a legislative chamber comes down to just a handful of seats. That means the work we do now — recruiting candidates, filling early budget gaps, building fundraising networks, and helping campaigns scale — can be the difference between winning and losing. ****=****** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being in this fight, the EMILYs List Campaigns team | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. subject: Organizing in Action: Help us reach voters, ballots drop soon!

body:
cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democrats,
Ballots for the June 2 Primary Election will be landing in mailboxes in just 17 days. Our organizers and dedicated volunteers are hard at work up and down the state talking with voters at the doors and on the phones to get out the vote.
From fighting for a more affordable future to protecting immigrant communities and defending our democracy, California is leading the fight to move our nation forward. Together, we will take back the House and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. The future we believe in is worth fighting for—we hope you'll join us!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20ICYMI%20Banner.png]
Last weekend, volunteers were busy knocking on doors and talking to voters about the issues that matter most to them. We had a great crew walking in Hemet, committed to doing the work to flip CA-48!
In the Central Valley, volunteers joined our Superwalk Weekend in Fresno which included knocking on doors and a full day of training on deep canvassing—a proven strategy that moves voters and builds lasting engagement.
https://linktr.ee/cadem [https://linktr.ee/cadem]
With the June 2 Primary Election less than 50 days out, we want to equip you with the tools you need to make a voting plan and ensure those around you are registered and ready for Election Day! Check out CADEM's online endorsement tool [https://cadem.org/our-endorsements/] to find endorsed Democrats where you live, and visit our Voter Information page [https://cadem.org/vote/] to find all the resources you need to vote.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20Upcoming%20Trainings%20Banner.png]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
Join our free, online April 21st training to hear directly from content creators Timisola Ogunleye and Jessica Craven about what works (and what doesn't) in digital organizing!
Register for our Monthly Training Series! [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/917181/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/917181/]
Looking for a way to get involved in defending our democracy and cutting Donald Trump's term in half? Join our volunteer intro call to find out how you can get involved!
Join our next California Fights Forward: 2026 Team Briefing [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/917181/]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20Take%20Action%20Banner.png]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
Every Monday, we call voters to help build up our volunteer base needed to take back the House! Every volunteer we recruit and every conversation we have with voters between now and Election Day matters—join us!
Recruit volunteers! [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
Join us every Tuesday and Thursday evening at 5:30pm from the comfort of your couch to make calls to voters in opportunity congressional districts.
Call voters! [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
Join us this weekend to knock on doors and talk to voters in critical congressional districts across the state.
Knock on doors! [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
Let's make every conversation we have with voters between now and June 2 count. I'll see you in the field!
- Helen Amelga
CADEM Organizing & Training Director

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The countdown is on. With only 1 week to go, we are excited to welcome you to the Autism Health Summit, taking place April 24–26, 2026 in San Diego at the Legacy Center Resort and Spa. This powerful three-day event brings together leading experts, practitioners, researchers, and families for a weekend of education, collaboration, and meaningful conversation around autism and neurological health.

We want to share an important update with our community. While the San Diego Regional Center will not be sponsoring tickets for this event due to unforeseen circumstances, we remain deeply committed to accessibility. We are offering scholarships for low-income families who would like to attend. You must apply by April 17th to receive approval. HERE is the link (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/autismhealth.com%2Fscholarships%2F/b43o/B73EAQ/AQ/515f375d-afa3-45de-a871-329b28e1135b/2/W_1CizjyLD?mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

As we approach the final weeks, we invite you to take advantage of our current offer. Use promo code Autism50 to receive $50 off your in-person ticket.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Earn CME Credits At the AHS Conference!
We are proud to offer Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for medical professionals attending the Autism Health Summit. Participants who purchase a Professional Ticket will be eligible to receive 10.5 CME credits, providing valuable, evidence-informed education while fulfilling continuing education requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for physicians and healthcare providers to gain deeper insights into emerging research, clinical applications, and integrative approaches to autism and neurological health.

Meet Our Headline Speakers!
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID

This year’s Summit features an outstanding lineup of headline speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Robert Malone, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, and Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, along with many more respected voices in the field. Attendees will also hear from Ed Clay and his team at Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), who will share the latest updates and research surrounding their upcoming clinical trial for autism.
AHS AGENDA (https://ahsconference.com/agenda/?mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Many Thanks to Our Sponsors!

We are deeply grateful to our top Diamond, Platinum, and Gold Sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

SPONSOR LINKS (https://ahsconference.com/sponsors/?mc_cid=aa13215e15&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.

subject: Governor Kemp: Do the right thing. Veto this bill.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
You don’t need to turn on HBO to find zombies. They’re right here in the Georgia State Capitol.
I’m not joking. Republicans advanced a “zombie bill” — a piece of legislation that was already dead, brought back to life through backroom maneuvering, and now being used to silence voters in some of Georgia’s most diverse, most populous counties.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
Here’s what’s happened: Republicans passed a bill that would strip party labels from key local races in counties like Gwinnett, DeKalb, Clayton, Cobb, and Fulton.
Let’s call this what it is. It’s about politicians who see power slipping away — and are trying to rewrite the rules to hold onto it.
Local leaders across metro Atlanta have already called out this bill as discriminatory, targeted, and unconstitutional. And I agree.
That’s why I stood with my colleagues and said: Governor Kemp — do the right thing. Veto this bill.
Our democracy should not be manipulated behind closed doors. And voters should not be disenfranchised just because those in power don’t like the outcome of elections.
This is exactly why I’ve never backed down from a fight.
Whether it’s standing up for science, calling out misinformation, or defending our democracy — I’ve always believed that leadership means speaking the truth, even when it’s uncomfortable
Now I’m running for Congress because we need that same fight in Washington. Because what’s happening in Georgia isn’t isolated — it’s part of a broader effort to undermine fair elections and hold onto power at any cost. And I’m not going to let that go unchallenged.
But I need your help. Our campaign is up against powerful interests that want to keep the system exactly as it is. If we’re going to fight back — and win — we need a strong grassroots movement behind us. Can you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us keep up this fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
Thank you,
Jasmine Clark

# Baumtoberfest 2026!
---
| |
A big THANK YOU to everyone who joined us for our annual “Baumtoberfest” at the end of March for a packed house at the old German Hall in Spokane. It was a fantastic way to kick-off this election cycle!We are very grateful to all of you who came to support the campaign, and to my colleague Rep. Brad Knott for travelling to Eastern Washington to be there with us.I was proud to raise a toast to our great team and volunteers, to our military servicemembers and veterans, and to President Trump for bringing secure borders, common sense and individual freedom back to America.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| |
# Lincoln Days across Eastern Washington!
---
| | My campaign team and I have really enjoyed the Lincoln Day events hosted by our GOP County parties across the 5th district.
At the Spokane County Lincoln Day, a highlight was the speech competition featuring young people talking on the importance of “Freedom’s Framework”. I was honored to introduce these outstanding speakers and all of us there were inspired by their passion and dedication to America’s founding principles.
We’ve also appreciated attending the Lincoln Day events in Ferry, Lincoln and Walla Walla counties. The work that our Republican grassroots does to promote conservative values and encourage our voters is so important and we are very grateful for all their efforts.

---
|
---
| | _With the speech competition finalists at Spokane County Lincoln Day_
---
| |
# Getting Involved!
---
| | Over these coming weeks and months, we’ll be attending parades, canvassing neighborhoods and rallying support all over the district. We would love to have your help!Please visit our website to [sign up](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=e3213c5358&e=5a45b9550e), or just reply to this email with your interest. Here are some ways you can get involved:
* Volunteer with the campaign for parades and events;

* Write letters to the editor;

* Host a yard sign (or a large sign!)

* [Knock on doors in your neighborhood.](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=4b698700b5&e=5a45b9550e)

**Coming up soon on Sunday May 3:** We’ll have volunteers sign-waving at the Bloomsday race in Spokane. Please send our coordinator Callie an [email](mailto:callie@votebaumgartner.com?subject=Bloomsday%20volunteer&body=) if you can join us!Thank you again for all your support!-Michael

Last night, 40 of 47 Democratic Senators voted to block the sale of military equipment to Israel.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2175%2E791427%2Eqv_xro)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260416-1-180&t=2&akid=2175%2E791427%2Eqv_xro)
---
For decades, the US government showed bipartisan support for sending weapons and aid to Israel as they violated international law, killed civilians, and maintained an indefinite occupation of Palestinian land.
**But the status quo has finally been broken.**
Last night, 40 of 47 Democratic Senators voted to block the sale of military equipment to Israel. That’s up from just a very small handful only a couple years ago, if not months.
**Make no mistake — this is a result of our tireless activism in the face of Israel’s brutal military campaigns and widespread crackdowns on free speech that criticizes Israel’s actions.**
This vote shows real progress and a transformation within the Democratic Party towards a more humane, more just, and more popular politics. We have grown the movement not just for Palestinian safety and self-determination, but for an end to needless and unjust violence anywhere in the world that is bankrolled by the US taxpayers.
As you know, Ilhan is a sponsor of the Block the Bombs Act in the House, which many of you have signed on to support. She’s also preparing to vote for the War Powers Resolution that would bring an end to Trump’s disastrous war with Iran. We’re asking you to take the next step today and help Ilhan keep up the pressure to get more members of Congress on board.
[**Please, if you can afford to, make a contribution to support Ilhan Omar as she keeps up this important fight. Americans want to see their tax money spent on things that make their lives better, not bombs and bulldozers that destroy communities.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260416-1-180&t=3&akid=2175%2E791427%2Eqv_xro)

In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

Ghost students are fabricated identities created by fraud rings who exploit higher education's financial aid systems. Criminal organizations enroll these non-existent students in colleges, particularly targeting community colleges with their open enrollment policies, to illegally obtain federal financial aid, student loans, and grants. Once funds are disbursed, the "students" disappear, leaving institutions with fraudulent enrollments and taxpayers with significant losses.

The scale of this operation is staggering. The U.S. Department of Education's Office of Inspector General reports approximately 200 active investigations nationwide into ghost student schemes, with over $350 million in fraudulent aid identified over the past five years alone.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.2vJNGGV20-Eya0dyq_gFD5bLagRH73RnEPlkaq6mP5k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=194435611)
The COVID-19 pandemic dramatically accelerated this form of fraud. As educational institutions rapidly shifted to online learning and virtual enrollment processes, vulnerabilities in identity verification systems became exposed. Jason Williams, Assistant Inspector General for Investigations at the U.S. Department of Education, noted that "when the pandemic hit, everybody went to online learning. Well, by doing that, it really did open the door" for more widespread fraud.

The fraudsters have become increasingly sophisticated, leveraging artificial intelligence to expand their operations and circumvent security measures. California Community Colleges reported nearly a third of all applications in 2024 were fraudulent, resulting in approximately $13 million in financial aid fraud that year alone.

Beyond the direct financial losses to taxpayers and institutions, the scheme creates devastating consequences for identity theft victims. Many individuals only discover they've been victimized when they receive unexpected loan statements or find themselves unable to obtain legitimate financial aid for their actual education.

For example, one father and son from the Washington D.C. area discovered their identities had been stolen when applying for college financial aid, only to find someone had already enrolled them in community colleges across the country and applied for loans and grants in their names.

Educational institutions are fighting back with enhanced verification protocols and AI-powered detection systems. Cerritos College in California implemented new vetting systems and live verification processes, reducing successful fraud attempts substantially--from millions in losses to just $5,000 in a single case they quickly resolved.

Delaware County Community College reported more than 500 ghost students enrolled in 2023 alone, forcing admissions departments to completely rethink their verification procedures. However, resource constraints at many community colleges create significant challenges to implementing comprehensive fraud prevention systems.

The ghost student phenomenon represents a significant threat to the financial stability of community colleges, which already operate on tight budgets and depend heavily on federal aid allocations. It also undermines public trust in higher education systems at a time when enrollment numbers are already declining.

Addressing this crisis will require coordinated efforts between educational institutions, federal agencies, and state lawmakers. Enhanced identity verification protocols, information sharing systems, and adequate funding for fraud prevention infrastructure are essential components of an effective response.

The ghost student scam demonstrates how criminal organizations exploit systemic vulnerabilities, particularly during periods of rapid change like the pandemic shift to online education. As this form of fraud continues to evolve, educational institutions and regulatory agencies must remain vigilant in protecting taxpayer resources and preserving the integrity of America's educational system.

Turns out some students aren't skipping class--they were never real to begin with. | | | Apr 16 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Ghost students are fabricated identities created by fraud rings who exploit higher education's financial aid systems. Criminal organizations enroll these non-existent students in colleges, particularly targeting community colleges with their open enrollment policies, to illegally obtain federal financial aid, student loans, and grants. Once funds are disbursed, the "students" disappear, leaving institutions with fraudulent enrollments and taxpayers with significant losses. The scale of this operation is staggering. The U.S. Department of Education's Office of Inspector General reports approximately 200 active investigations nationwide into ghost student schemes, with over $350 million in fraudulent aid identified over the past five years alone. The COVID-19 pandemic dramatically accelerated this form of fraud. As educational institutions rapidly shifted to online learning and virtual enrollment processes, vulnerabilities in identity verification systems became exposed. Jason Williams, Assistant Inspector General for Investigations at the U.S. Department of Education, noted that "when the pandemic hit, everybody went to online learning. Well, by doing that, it really did open the door" for more widespread fraud. The fraudsters have become increasingly sophisticated, leveraging artificial intelligence to expand their operations and circumvent security measures. California Community Colleges reported nearly a third of all applications in 2024 were fraudulent, resulting in approximately $13 million in financial aid fraud that year alone. Beyond the direct financial losses to taxpayers and institutions, the scheme creates devastating consequences for identity theft victims. Many individuals only discover they've been victimized when they receive unexpected loan statements or find themselves unable to obtain legitimate financial aid for their actual education. For example, one father and son from the Washington D.C. area discovered their identities had been stolen when applying for college financial aid, only to find someone had already enrolled them in community colleges across the country and applied for loans and grants in their names. Educational institutions are fighting back with enhanced verification protocols and AI-powered detection systems. Cerritos College in California implemented new vetting systems and live verification processes, reducing successful fraud attempts substantially--from millions in losses to just $5,000 in a single case they quickly resolved. Delaware County Community College reported more than 500 ghost students enrolled in 2023 alone, forcing admissions departments to completely rethink their verification procedures. However, resource constraints at many community colleges create significant challenges to implementing comprehensive fraud prevention systems. The ghost student phenomenon represents a significant threat to the financial stability of community colleges, which already operate on tight budgets and depend heavily on federal aid allocations. It also undermines public trust in higher education systems at a time when enrollment numbers are already declining. Addressing this crisis will require coordinated efforts between educational institutions, federal agencies, and state lawmakers. Enhanced identity verification protocols, information sharing systems, and adequate funding for fraud prevention infrastructure are essential components of an effective response. The ghost student scam demonstrates how criminal organizations exploit systemic vulnerabilities, particularly during periods of rapid change like the pandemic shift to online education. As this form of fraud continues to evolve, educational institutions and regulatory agencies must remain vigilant in protecting taxpayer resources and preserving the integrity of America's educational system. clean_body: | | | Do a “deal” with Trump or face 100% tariff... sick Americans be damned. The Trump administration has officially descended into a state of pure, unadulterated medical authoritarianism. In a move that redefines incompetence as a lethal weapon, they are now threatening life-saving pharmaceutical companies with a catastrophic 100% tariff unless these companies surrender to the administration’s "deal." Let’s be chillingly clear about the stakes: This isn't just a trade war. It is a hostage situation where the disability community is the primary target. If these tariffs go through, the cost of the medications we need to breathe, move, and survive will skyrocket beyond reach, or simply vanish from the shelves. This administration is effectively holding a gun to the head of our healthcare system, willing to trigger a national mortality crisis just to satisfy a bully’s ego. For us, this isn't politics. It’s a matter of life or death. At Able Dems, we are the line of defense against this insanity. We are fighting to elect disabled Democrats and allies who will treat this extortion as the human rights violation it truly is. We need leaders who understand that when you gamble with medicine, people die. We are out of time for polite disagreement. We need to flood the halls of power with advocates who will stop this death-march policy in its tracks. | | Dear Peter,
---
We have great news! Thanks to your support, we’re now moving full steam ahead with the expansion of **[Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve](https://click.everyaction.com/k/129601374/614901135/-479769549?utm_source=ea-news&utm_campaign=hrrre-success&utm_medium=email&sourceid=1169018&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhMDNlMjg4LWMzMzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=zMWXIaNBrGbUaiimG2yXH2phD1k5VlTFM2QtbdhCSEk=&emci=c307ee17-6537-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=3a03e288-c339-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=1504551)**. Once the land purchase is complete, the reserve will grow by more than 25%—to 930 acres—extending lasting protection to even more ancient coast redwoods in this extraordinary landscape. We’re deeply grateful to our key fundraising partners, including the Troper Wojcicki Foundation and members and supporters of Save the Redwoods, who are helping to secure the remaining funds needed to finalize the expansion. Donations have come from nine countries and all 50 U.S. states. **This couldn’t have happened without your incredible generosity—thank you.**
---
---
Working with our partners, the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians, we use prescribed burning at the reserve to build wildfire resilience. Photo by Sashwa Burrous.
---
Here’s what this expansion will provide: **A bigger, stronger reserve.** Growing the reserve to 930 acres creates a vital buffer against development and fragmentation and reduces wildfire risk for the old-growth groves at the center of the existing reserve. **A powerful climate solution.** Old-growth coast redwoods store more carbon per acre than any forest on Earth—including the Amazon rainforest—making their protection a critical climate investment. **Protection for imperiled wildlife.** The expansion includes vital spawning grounds for steelhead trout and coho salmon. **More public access.** This expansion allows us to take the next steps toward thoughtfully and responsibly opening the reserve for public enjoyment, in close collaboration with the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians.
---
In 2018, when we acquired the reserve, we protected one of the largest remaining ancient redwood forests once held in private hands. The reserve is so remarkable, _Outside_ magazine called it the “Shangri-la of conservation.” Now, thanks to your support, we’re building on that legacy and strengthening protection for this extraordinary place. The final purchase is expected later this year. Stay tuned for what’s next.
---
| | With gratitude,
---
Save the Redwoods League

subject: We wish we had better news
body:
---
Derek, We wish we had better news, but we fell short of our mid-month fundraising goal last night. As one of our top grassroots supporters, it’s important to us that we keep you informed — and that means sharing the good, the bad, and the ugly with you. Here’s the good news: **We still have time to make up the difference between now and our end-of-month fundraising deadline.** We know that you get a _lot_ of emails about fundraising deadlines from other organizations. We hope you’ll let us explain why it’s so important that we hit our goals:
* The DNC is fighting back against Trump and his allies on all fronts. We’re taking them on in court to protect voting rights. We’re hiring hundreds of organizers to register thousands of new Democrats in battleground states. We’re working day in and day out to minimize the damage Trump can cause by taking back control of Congress this November.
* This work takes a massive number of people and a huge amount of money. We carefully calculate our fundraising goals every month to ensure that we have the resources we need to keep expanding our efforts and build the largest midterm operation in DNC history — because that’s the kind of operation it’s going to take to win back Congress this November.

**If everyone receiving this email chipped in $7, we’d hit our end-of-month fundraising goal weeks early, but the truth is that less than one percent will give.** [**So, Derek, please chip in $7 to the DNC today to help us get back on track to meet our end-of-month goal. We’ll put your donation to work immediately to help elect Democrats up and down the ballot all across the country.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-april-2026?refcode=em_20260416_6736_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6736_22930333_OSKFTz&akid=6736%2E22930333%2EOSKFTz) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-april-2026?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260416_6736_fr&refcode2=6736_22930333_OSKFTz&akid=6736%2E22930333%2EOSKFTz)**

You’re fighting back too. In states like California and Virginia, people are refusing to roll over while Republicans try to game the system to preserve their own power.
What started here in Texas is spreading.
And next week in Virginia, this fight reaches another turning point.
Republicans thought they could rig the maps, silence voters, and get away with it.

These fights are only possible because of people like you, Peter.

Peter,

For too long, the medical establishment got away with mutilating children in the name of "gender-affirming care."

They gave puberty blockers to 13-year-olds, performed double mastectomies on 15-year-olds. And when the complications started -- when the regret set in -- the medical establishment walked away. _**No consequences. No accountability. Just billions in profit.**_

[_**The Chloe Cole Act changes that.**_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/qVvx-7ssoKEJbxiQeHkUAVO49xGex8Lt1NhDKIoKllSGnNvJfW8C6KmQp7UkwbygIWNbR5p8CYLCu8PlCTvsSWaFrpJfhXUDsqhv3NXLfIb46DsoG5zwmJFkp-p6zDkML_GjwK7PL3pWNF2yR3Mz1eqiG7kC5mXuEbpDMnbs44kQPoQeOmmroyAcw2LLmttnKzfOAkoFAHB3zaF4GouOg5HgK9MVdZGuwWGBUDlXur1LOGAE2PzMfg6yYlvl0sxSLXTucFaAbhpaePyUsvyBsX367OBGckq1dRz4-gWhvGOYyz7EMzuB4MAHWN3ygac-c_q7R3bOBpuy7DAByeLWnmLr7SYbsGjr4ghWWLwJDrAZTcTtwJbryWLkXp5--yikDkGIo3_xG6mBneJ11WRGh2506e1vleJULCYYXITQ6MaPLQWdPfHf5vgO9JkJ2YMNfsPpgO8i7hH7X_WfgkKHPU7Ycwq8l-7V5vuFY-au5REE6cmUSmsrFONtfPRRu21oAxAmqg94RiS8325Zwxx8SoqfJR6m1Ub4rKd8G_pJr8GxEKTiqrgtqtm5EfMgAzmp2U4fC7M8Ld03FDi5gB2aNKeyvgUHoT4pWqNDrJjA2ix5YsixvFv5q043JrRyM-zTWtuCn3yplEaoWbKm7JGJLhAGhtbCqj-zsVspYI6E7E0lJZ4N8qrjY3U0eHa1XxMre7HA/XRZHsndUBC59EIjQcq4ycoD4dIxDtubV/19)

This bill gives victims (and their parents) of this medical malpractice the legal power to sue the doctors, hospitals, and clinics responsible for these **irreversible harms. **

---

| | Hi friends!
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Also, don't miss our deep-dive video on [tax day in Colorado](https://link.email.joinrmv.) & [how this year was different](https://link.email.joinrmv.) with Trump's federal tax credits! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are advancing policies drawing pushback as [employers report cutting wages](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and hiring amid rising regulatory costs, while [controversial social bills](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on counseling and parental rights move forward after a Supreme Court ruling. Budget tensions are also growing as officials work to close a shortfall alongside [declining TABOR refunds](https://link.email.joinrmv.).

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** More than 200 business leaders—including Gov. Polis—are warning [state policies are hurting competitiveness](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while regulators [overruled local officials](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to approve a $1.7B energy project. Education debates continue over [reduced testing](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and a [Title IX dispute in Jeffco schools](https://link.email.joinrmv.). A new commentary encourages parents to take a [more active role in their children’s education](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Federal scrutiny is rising over Colorado’s court rule [limiting immigration enforcement cooperation](https://link.email.joinrmv.), as Congress investigates potential conflicts with federal law, while the [state Supreme Court weighs a transgender care case](https://link.email.joinrmv.) that could carry major federal funding implications.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 16, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Where did your TABOR refund go? Follow the spending](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY REP. JARVIS CALDWELL & REP. GABE EVANS, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
_TABOR, otherwise known as the Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights, was created to protect Coloradans from bloated government spending, prevent politicians from overtaxing working families, and ensure extra revenue is returned to the people who earned it. But under Governor Polis’ fiscal mismanagement and runaway spending, Coloradans are paying the price — through dramatically reduced TABOR refunds this year and no refunds at all next year._ _
__TABOR is a provision in the Colorado Constitution passed by voters in 1992 that puts strict limits on how much the government can tax, spend, and grow unless otherwise voted on and approved. It ensures government spending increases only by inflation and population growth and requires excess revenue to be refunded to taxpayers._ _
__When managed responsibly TABOR delivers meaningful refunds — often $600-$1600 depending on filing status. When mismanaged, taxpayers lose. That’s what’s happening now._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Less Pay. Less Jobs. Businesses Blame Overregulation](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Businesses report wage cuts and hiring slowdowns:** A survey of Colorado employers found 67% reduced wages and 51% held off on hiring due to state regulatory costs, with many saying regulations are raising prices and hurting growth.
* **Leaders warn Colorado is losing competitiveness:** More than 200 business and tech leaders—including the governor—signed a letter saying the state is becoming less competitive due to regulatory and policy decisions impacting jobs and investment.
* **Companies and jobs leaving the state:** Since 2019, Colorado has seen 98 company relocations or lost opportunities tied to over 13,600 jobs, as employers cite regulatory burdens and more favorable business climates elsewhere.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: I spent yesterday at Lone Star college in Houston.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240796%2E444211%2EQzRhGt)
I spent yesterday at Lone Star college in Houston. It's one of our great community colleges, a place where young -- and older -- Texans get their start or get to start again. And it's also full of voters and future voters. More than 20,000 students attend classes at the CyFair campus where we set up.
Towards the end of the day I met a young woman named Alexandra who said "the reason I like you guys, is you're not for the system. You're for the people." I liked that. For so many young people who are turned off not only by Trump but also by the entire status quo political system -- including at times the Democratic party -- Powered by People offers a chance to work with everyday people to change a system that has so badly failed us.
We don't do it through technology, we don't do it through money. We do it by meeting, listening to and then working with people to use their full political power.
Like Ilya, Rafael and Elizabeth of Lone Star MASA (Mexican American Student Association), who interviewed me for their student publication and talked to me about building student voting power. Right away, I loved the energy and intensity and their focus on working to make things better.
I also met Oscar who, with his brother and dad started an HVAC business in Houston. He’s now at Lone Star learning the fundamentals of business management. With pride he told me that his dad is an immigrant who has worked hard to make a life for himself and his family here and to make this a better country. His mom works in oil and gas and wants her sons to build the business big enough that they can afford to give back to the community.
Kellen, the Lone Star student body president introduced himself, told me what he’s working on and asked how he could get involved in politics and I said you’re already doing it! Expecting great things from him down the road.
I talked Patricia who, in addition to attending school, provides foster care for unaccompanied refugee children through the local Catholic charities.
Special education teacher Candance came over to say hello and introduced me to one of her students, Damien, a wonderful young man. I also met Marianne the bus driver who brought them to Lone Star today.
An aspiring filmmaker, Matteo, showed me his copy of Dear America: letters home from Vietnam which he's reading for history class. We talked about war, the war in Iran and how we somehow never seem to learn... well, maybe some of us do, but not the guy in the White House. We need to remember that when we vote.
Raul, history teacher from El Paso (went to Coronado AND Andress!) came out with a stack of vintage senate stickers he’d had in his desk for the last 8 years. I guess just waiting for us to show up!
Here's the thing -- I met at least a hundred more people over the course of the day, a hundred more conversations and stories, and that's just me. Our other volunteers at Lone Star and other campuses across the state we were on met many more, adding to the tens of thousands of voters that we've personally met, registered and stayed in touch with to help them vote.
That's what's so special about Powered by People. For the people, not the system. We do the work of meeting people where they are, listening to them, getting to know them and then helping them use their power to vote to change what is possible in this country.
[**Your help keeps us out there, thanks for chipping in.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260416.cfwleY&refcode=ema20260416-240796&t=3&akid=240796%2E444211%2EQzRhGt)

Beto

clean_body: | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Peter, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. **I haven’t taken a traditional path to the U.S. Senate.**
For 5 years, I was a geologist — I started out studying volcanoes! :-). Then, our company got bought, and we all got laid off. I was out of work for two years. Eventually, I took every scrap of savings in my bank account, even put my house up as collateral, to open a brewpub in downtown Denver.
Our rent back then was $1/sq ft/yr!
I remember the first day when I walked into that restaurant and realized what we’d done. We brought people together and created a team that was really going to do something special!
I found my way to public office because I was fed up with everyday Coloradans’ voices being drowned out by corporate interests and the wealthy. I ran for Mayor of Denver, Governor of Colorado, and eventually, U.S. Senate. Through it all, my focus has remained the same: bring people together and actually solve problems.
Turns out, that resonated with a heck of a lot of Coloradans. In 2020, we flipped this Senate seat from red to blue and have delivered huge victories in the Senate — from passing legislation to tackle climate change head-on to fighting to lower housing costs for families.
**I’m proud of the work we’ve accomplished together so far, and we’re ready to keep moving Colorado forward. But here’s the thing: National Republicans and corporate PACs are going to pour millions of dollars into Colorado to try to take back this seat.**
If we’re going to go head-to-head with them and win, we’ll need a serious people-powered movement. So we’re coming to you:

Team,

My job as a broadcast journalist was to hold local businesses accountable when they took advantage of people.

One day, an elderly woman called our tip line about faulty tires she'd been sold by an auto shop. She didn't know what to do. She couldn't just walk back in there and demand answers.

My cameraman and I went into that shop, confronted the owners, and got that woman her money back.

That's what I mean when I say I want to give people a voice.

That woman needed someone to stand up for her, and so do the people of this district. Right now, the Trump administration and Republicans in Washington are treating working families like they don’t count. I’ll go into Congress just like I did that shop, and I will get results.

If you’re tired of seeing your representatives worry more about making headlines than delivering real results, chip in to my campaign. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw_em?refcode=260416_mgw_voice_l1]

body:
| I want you to hear this directly from me.
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/10884?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.16_James-Running_B1_F1_S1_C1_tarsync-T1_N-T0&t=4&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX) Hi Peter, it’s Tish James, and I want you to hear this directly from me: **I’m officially running for reelection as New York’s Attorney General.** [**Before I share more, will you become a Founding Donor of my reelection campaign by splitting a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/10884?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.16_James-Running_B1_F1_S1_C1_tarsync-T1_N-T0&t=5&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX) Since 2019, I’ve had the honor of serving the people of New York. I’ve taken on the powerful — from big corporations, to the ultra-wealthy, to powerful politicians like Donald Trump — and delivered real results for New Yorkers. When the Trump administration pushed their dangerous and immoral policies that target our immigrant neighbors, I fought back because protecting all New Yorkers makes us stronger. When Donald Trump defrauded the people of New York, I took him to court and held him accountable. And as Trump and extreme Republicans ramp up their attacks on everything we stand for – threatening immigrants’ rights, raising prices for working people, and launching efforts to roll back voting rights – I’m using the full power of the attorney general’s office to fight back. That’s why it’s no surprise Donald Trump is targeting me. He knows I won’t stop holding him and his administration accountable, and he’s mobilizing the entire weight of the Department of Justice to come after me because of it. But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it's that you can never back down from a bully. **I’m running for reelection, Peter, and I need you on my side to keep fighting for the rights of New Yorkers and people all across this country.** [**The road ahead is going to be long and expensive, Peter, and I’m grateful to have Blue Amp Action in this fight with me. Will you split a donation of any amount between my campaign and Blue Amp Action so we can start this race off strong?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/10884?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.16_James-Running_B1_F1_S1_C1_tarsync-T1_N-T0&t=6&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX) | [DONATE >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/10884?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.16_James-Running_B1_F1_S1_C1_tarsync-T1_N-T0&t=7&akid=2096%2E259176%2EIjC1gX)
---
Together, we’ll keep up the fight for justice, progress, and equality.
Thank you,
Tish James
Attorney General of New York

The midterms are coming up, and we can’t do this work without you. With your support, we'll work to halt the right-wing agenda and support strong Democrats who will fight for us across the country.

### Training Opportunity: Become a Treasurer
2026 candidates like Chris will need support. This means knocking on doors, going to events, donating, and gathering signatures. For independent candidates, it also means finding an experienced Campaign Treasurer. This role isn't difficult, but it takes a responsible person who can commit to filing the paperwork. It's a great opportunity for people who want to help an independent candidate without the pressure of talking to voters. _(Independent introverts unite!)_ It can even lead to paid roles down the road.
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=BaB4xvCKLCz8qa3CFjrPn_ruO5tIYY30uiDDdkzVz-E8wMrIKoRR0AGSJ0IImY7V&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_april_call_invite&n=9)
_Lead PA_ is holding a training for campaign treasurers April 27. It's online and free; you just have to [RSVP](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=BaB4xvCKLCz8qa3CFjrPn_ruO5tIYY30uiDDdkzVz-E8wMrIKoRR0AGSJ0IImY7V&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_april_call_invite&n=10) by April 24. If you think you'd be willing to help a campaign in this way, please consider attending this training.
* * *
### Special Election Updates
The next special election is very important to us because we have a horse in the race. It will be held May 19, also known as Primary Day!
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_april_call_invite&n=11)
On [January's statewide call](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c1vIqT8LaeJ1yAWpG61iLl6fQsq-0_vrqRWgviHRXbWlMZEVxl0MBTeRVtDkSuMbFF0LNKsSEAr_F4dfjE1u3w&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_april_call_invite&n=12), we heard from recently-announced Forward affiliate [Ron Ruman](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_april_call_invite&n=13). He told us about his plan to run as a Forward Democrat for the PA State House in the 196th district (York County). On January 29, Seth Grove announced his resignation, triggering this special election.
In this situation, Pennsylvania's antiquated closed primary system is especially relevant. Ron is relying on support from independent voters to win his race, but independents don't normally vote on primary day (because closed primaries shut them out), so turnout of independent voters might be low. **Ron needs help getting the word out to the independents in his district that THIS ELECTION is a chance to have their voices heard.** Please reach out if you're interested in helping.

If we have to do it again, we will.
But defending democracy requires a strong grassroots team prepared to meet the fight head-on — and that’s where you come in.
If you believe, as I do, that no president should be able to manufacture an emergency to grab control over elections, I’m asking you to stand with me. Please contribute today to help us protect Oregon’s elections and hold President Trump accountable before it’s too late. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260416em]

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: What does healthcare mean to you? 🤔
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
📣 LAST CALL 📣
Take our survey and tell us how you'd change healthcare in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20HC%20survey.jpg]
We’re in the FINAL week of our healthcare survey collection, so have your voice heard by taking it today.
Your input will help shape the direction and demands of a new unified campaign TOP is embarking on. (Stay tuned for more!)
No matter how our healthcare system has impacted you, we want to hear from you. Tell us what REAL healthcare looks like in your eyes, share your personal health story, and let us know how you would improve the system!
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform]
Hosting State Power Caucus partners in Dallas this week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20SPC%20pic.jpeg]
A rewarding last two days it's been, as TOP Education Fund had the pleasure of hosting State Power Caucus partners at our Dallas office, to break bread, strategize, and exchange best practices.
As our movement evolves, so must our ability to connect with one another, as our organizations all seek to move crucial community-building work forward in our respective states.
Learn more about the State Power Caucus here. [https://statepowercaucus.org/]
Head to the polls:
May 2nd local elections are coming up
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20here%20aqui.png]
May 2nd local elections will soon be here for a handful of cities and counties across Texas.
In-person early voting is April 20 and April 22-28, so remember to head to the polls!
From school district bonds to city council races, check what will be on your ballot here. [https://www.texastribune.org/2026/04/10/texas-2026-local-elections-guide-arlington-school-board-dallas-isd/]
TOP Tips: Learn about Black Maternal Health Week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20Black%20maternal%20health%20week%20-%20Mom%20and%20baby.jpg]
EVERY Texan is deserving of access to birthing justice — regardless of age, race, gender, or income level. As we commemorate Black Maternal Health Week , it's essential to bring attention to the persistent and alarming disparities in maternal health outcomes affecting Black women in Texas and across the country. Together, we can work to dismantle the barriers that perpetuate these disparities and create a more just and equitable healthcare system that serves all mothers equally, one birth at a time. Learn more here and how you can get involved in this organizing fight. [https://blkmaternalhealthweek.com/]
Español
📣 ÚLTIMA OPORTUNIDAD 📣
Participa en nuestra encuesta y cuéntano cómo cambiarías el sistema de salud en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20HC%20survey.jpg]
Estamos en la ÚLTIMA semana de recolección de nuestra encuesta sobre atención médica; ¡haz oír tu voz respondiéndola hoy mismo!
Tus aportaciones ayudarán a definir el rumbo y las demandas de una nueva campaña unificada que TOP está poniendo en marcha. (¡Mantente al tanto para más detalles!)
Independientemente de cómo te haya afectado nuestro sistema de salud, queremos escucharte. Queremos saber cómo es para usted una atención médica REAL. Comparta su historia y sus ideas para transformar el sistema de salud.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform]
Recibimos a los aliados del Caucus de Poder Estatal en Dallas esta semana
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20SPC%20pic.jpeg]
Han sido dos días muy gratificantes, ya que TOP Education Fund tuvo el placer de recibir a los aliados del State Power Caucus en nuestra oficina de Dallas para compartir una comida, planear estrategias e intercambiar mejores prácticas.
A medida que nuestro movimiento evoluciona, también debe hacerlo nuestra capacidad para conectar entre nosotros, ya que todas nuestras organizaciones buscan impulsar un trabajo fundamental para fortalecer a nuestras comunidades en nuestros respectivos estados.
Obtenga más información sobre el State Power Caucus aquí. [https://statepowercaucus.org/]
Ve a votar:
Se acercan las elecciones locales del 2 de mayo
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20here%20aqui.png]
Las elecciones locales del 2 de mayo ya están muy cerca para varias ciudades y condados en todo Texas.
La votación anticipada en persona tendrá lugar el 20 de abril y del 22 al 28 de abril, ¡así que recuerda ir a votar!
Desde bonos para distritos escolares hasta contiendas por el concejo municipal, consulte aquí qué aparecerá en su boleta electoral. [https://www.texastribune.org/2026/04/10/texas-2026-local-elections-guide-arlington-school-board-dallas-isd/]
Consejos de TOP:
Infórmate sobre la Semana de la Salud Materna Afrodescendiente
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20Black%20maternal%20health%20week%20-%20Mom%20and%20baby.jpg]
Todos los tejano merecen tener acceso a la justicia en el parto, independientemente de su edad, raza, género o nivel de ingresos. Al conmemorar la Semana de la Salud Materna de las Mujeres Afrodescendientes , es fundamental visibilizar las desigualdades persistentes y alarmantes disparidades en los resultados de salud materna que afectan a las mujeres Afrodescendientes en Texas y en todo el país. Juntos, podemos trabajar para desmantelar las barreras que perpetúan estas disparidades y crear un sistema de salud más justo y equitativo que sirva a todas las madres por igual, un nacimiento a la vez. Obtenga más información aquí y descubra cómo puede involucrarse en esta lucha organizativa. [https://blkmaternalhealthweek.com/]

Peter, Donald Trump’s ICE has been operating without proper oversight and accountability for months. As a former prosecutor and as someone who’s fought to hold powerful actors accountable, I’ve seen how unchecked power works, and I won’t stand by while basic rights are trampled. We need to abolish ICE. In the meantime, I have introduced legislation to rein it in and stand up to this administration’s lawlessness and corruption.
1. My **No Secret Police Act** requires all DHS and ICE agents to clearly display their official identification and badges during civil immigration enforcement operations — a crucial step to ensure transparency, accountability, and fairness in immigration enforcement.
2. The **ICE OUT Act** would remove qualified immunity protections from ICE agents and ensure they are held accountable, not given a get-out-of-jail-free card.
3. The **Real Courts, Rule of Law Act** would protect immigration judges from Trump’s attacks and reform the immigration court system.
4. The**Immigration Court Due Process Protection Act** protects immigrants who adhere to legal pathways to prevent them from being targeted and arrested at courthouses.
5. And my **Upholding Protections for Unaccompanied Children Act** would protect vulnerable immigrant children by reversing parts of Trump’s Big Ugly Bill that threaten the safety of children seeking refuge in the U.S.

The lack of oversight over ICE agents while they abduct people off the street is not just terrifying and contrary to democracy. It is un-American. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I’ve never campaigned like the establishment says you’re supposed to
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I recently had the honor of filing the community signatures necessary to submit my candidacy for re-election.
We submitted over 10,000 signatures: **the highest number we have ever received across The Bronx and Queens.**
Now, we’re headed into our June 23rd primary election.
I’m facing two Democratic opponents, and I’m counting your support to continue fighting for working people everywhere.
Over the past eight years, we’ve proven what’s possible when working people come together and organize.
We grew the Green New Deal, taxed the rich, and brought our progressive movement from coast to coast.
My opponents have spent over $13 million to defeat us in recent years. Big money interests are scared because they know I’ll never stop taking them on and being a brawler for the working class.
When you take on corporate power, when you refuse to play by the traditional campaign playbook, they come for you.
_We have to expect that kind of spending again this year._
I’ve never campaigned like the establishment says you’re supposed to. I don’t spend my days calling donors like most members of Congress.
We’re going to continue creating a new way to do politics rooted in community organizing and building a movement of working-class voices that went unheard for far too long.
I’m not going to change my priorities or how I campaign in this election. But that means I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to keep me in this fight.
[If I can count on your support, chip in an amount that makes sense to you toward my re-election campaign today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260416.eZYD_R&refcode=em20260416-11198-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=11198%2E2526796%2EWrjuTE)

We submitted over 10,000 signatures: the highest number we have ever received across The Bronx and Queens. Now, we’re headed into our June 23rd primary election. I’m facing two Democratic opponents, and I’m counting your support to continue fighting for working people everywhere. Over the past eight years, we’ve proven what’s possible when working people come together and organize. We grew the Green New Deal, taxed the rich, and brought our progressive movement from coast to coast. My opponents have spent over $13 million to defeat us in recent years. Big money interests are scared because they know I’ll never stop taking them on and being a brawler for the working class. When you take on corporate power, when you refuse to play by the traditional campaign playbook, they come for you. We have to expect that kind of spending again this year. I’ve never campaigned like the establishment says you’re supposed to. I don’t spend my days calling donors like most members of Congress. We’re going to continue creating a new way to do politics rooted in community organizing and building a movement of working-class voices that went unheard for far too long. I’m not going to change my priorities or how I campaign in this election. But that means I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to keep me in this fight. Pa’lante, Alexandria | ---|--- | | | ---|---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

This is outrageous. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129606798/614919389/-1903256646?refcode=-SB-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzJhMmNmN2MtZDEzOS1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VhKiEtrMoWTD5q8UylxJ6Y4adSlMCguJhWkzurbtFhg=) | Peter, I couldn't believe it when Donald Trump said, “It’s not possible to take care of daycare.” Now, he's proposing a $1 billion cut to childcare funding for working families. As a father of two little girls who understands how much it costs to pay for daycare these days, this enrages me! **Affordable childcare shouldn’t be a luxury in the richest country on Earth.
