| | Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

Hi friends —

I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you.

**This week, we asked you to help us raise $5,000 to get our field program off the ground — to fund the clipboards and the printed materials and the interns and the infrastructure that makes “showing up statewide” actually possible. And you showed up for us.**

That’s not a small thing. Every dollar that came in this week is going toward a very specific, very practical goal: getting this team on the ground in May, knocking doors across Rhode Island, and making sure this campaign can meet voters where they are.

From Ward 3 to all of Rhode Island — I don’t take that lightly. I don’t take your support lightly, either.

If you weren’t able to give this week and you’d like to, it’s never too late: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sue_aprilmm#chip-in](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqucTtwdhB9JCqTOmaNtHEtXiPNxmTn8VQdBe_5QNIMOhJPwx3Dg3aBM9SRrL0eZMNIkBRXcJogjr1E-LAxXlWlLfjoCsEtS2f-aHW7h4H7R4jPhIjRJeMT35ZSel5ItTqYUZx0fkWiPp5Vk7n9LKqphPNyL5n7oKsrwBooFL7nKRrPDDzXWi5VMLo3gzltcP_M_Zt3zldDcmAV0-W7K1WEvn7rPgJAHZN4bYB8IVnNCdvB1GVibmaL_KiDhHQ4xYTvpPbkbEkC6Mlbg8Y7E4tOflY_bYRTVCQz-5QLAVcZfoXImJrv7pg0nX_-2iOFXkWLaTRkYbP2gji-2k2dDuahf/4pu/KQYkiqjpSfqfLby7Huc6iQ/h0/h001.m-2UXAMuEFnI49nmCjLx_Sbyuz7VhOzXV9H4KPbHabQ)**

I also have something fun to tell you about. 🌱

Hi null,

🩺 People are anxious about affording health care.
🛟 They’re worried about the future of Medicare and Social Security.

💰 Grocery prices are too damn high.

👷 Working Michiganders want real action to create and protect good-paying jobs.

🗳️ And many are deeply concerned about our civil rights, democracy, and basic freedoms.
These aren’t political talking points – they’re real concerns from real people. And that’s exactly why I’m running for U.S. Senate in Michigan. Because when I see a problem, I get to work:
✅ I helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs as part of President Obama’s Auto Rescue Task Force.

✅ I led the charge to bring semiconductor manufacturing back to Michigan.

✅ I introduced the No Tariffs on Groceries Act to stop reckless food tariffs that are raising grocery prices.

✅ And I filed articles of impeachment against RFK Jr. for endangering public health.
I was recently named one of the most effective lawmakers in Congress – because I pride myself on showing up, listening, and delivering for working families.

body:
You’re the heart and soul of the MAGA movement.
| I need to apologize to you.
I'm sorry, truly I am.
I'm sorry that some people accuse you of not being MAGA if you don't make a donation.
I'm sorry that some people lie to you about who they are to try to trick you into donating.
And I'm sorry that many folks don't even show their appreciation when you do donate.
It drives me crazy that people try to treat you like that, and it's important to hear why I do things differently.
First things first.
This is Majority Leader Steve Scalise.
Secondly, I want to thank you for all of the support you've given to the GOP over the years; it really means a lot.
But right now we're staring down some concerning numbers, and it has my team and I really worried.
The Democrats are currently unloading 100 million dollars into 35 GOP seats to obliterate our House Majority once and for all, and here is the truth: Right now, we simply don't have the funds to fully fund our campaign operations in all 35 races.
[So the simple truth is that I need your help before our House Majority is a thing of the past.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=9117e6ed358247cc8484bbb47907c597&_e=sQ6yueeXRQCNYmgAWFiehYFW0g8MsW3-zvXzqH-H7YeCsPP7LRyt7KJCMWcmZblc-5o-YdpOy0-uawpgo3RLHvKwJD2DLsVEpKhS0CU-zPuv0GAcCMTOSgwS3YwqYuXAEFWZcdLU1TZpKT_DE_bwg-wLyLOm3lmNBcYEMmQwOk9zbQliBk0_vzngbF8DNK7HDl9bJfZJhQQDHRoQ0uWTSQ_E4eCnhG1gRa4xcHptalTS4LTWDPwzJ_yU3f7HeFAG3x2Tjm7RTyiqXzvg4QUpfl73bFC2Z6i5tjjmISvf0aq2d93obiOvcUMckXGonm-fuh6kftJHcEE3mnoU7rKgfvffvP8faR-9nPwb76NbRbzDzrxw8nis2MKuJj5xzHoDVj8ck-myy0MXjo4bCvN7AtfnExEmTb5YMOlV4okqmontE58gjHVbhjbWIq8SBA8vNsF8P3wtvcmdQXoubCOjeOQvKOeIAoeIr5rPCTQjYz7F8w8KAy2QmiGM1GEkK9J-XRhYVDQmS3capxp-39dBRLlYofRSyXd3UJfar-ass03w9PWqXIszoxuHJu6hPipD7gUl7Pt-NhKJk_3dpUmk5w6rbfpuD9kxbMShi1Hh5LV5vc0AIwvEYmcK4sA4-T2-0C1k9YSam85L8gLIx5rPzts0HJgba5F-tTxs4z4ZfikYuK2gyF6m3gisN3ZEe5Wc6dJuSBtNGiA-PDO9_8JZ9Q%3D%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

I’m reaching out to you today for the very first time to ask for your personal endorsement as I run for the Republican nomination for the United States Senate in Minnesota.

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the freedoms and way of life we hold dear. As a SEAL, I learned to thrive in the toughest environments — and that same grit and determination is exactly what I’m bringing to this race.

Unlike my progressive, far-left Democrat opponents, I’m not cosplaying as a Somali Muslim to win over the votes of a leftist base who want nothing more out of the midterms than impeaching Donald Trump.

**I’m especially proud that in recent months I have won nearly all of the straw polls conducted by local Republican organizations across Minnesota.** These early victories show that conservatives are ready for a battle-tested leader who will take the fight to Washington and deliver real results for our state.

We are on track to win the endorsement of the delegates to the Minnesota Republican Party in May but we need to expand our support now to win in November. We’ve set an ambitious goal of securing **20,000 more conservative endorsements** to demonstrate the size and strength of this grassroots movement heading into my August primary. clean_body: You might not know me, but your support in this race matters more than you’ll ever know. | Fellow Conservative, I’m reaching out to you today for the very first time to ask for your personal endorsement as I run for the Republican nomination for the United States Senate in Minnesota. My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the freedoms and way of life we hold dear. As a SEAL, I learned to thrive in the toughest environments — and that same grit and determination is exactly what I’m bringing to this race. Unlike my progressive, far-left Democrat opponents, I’m not cosplaying as a Somali Muslim to win over the votes of a leftist base who want nothing more out of the midterms than impeaching Donald Trump. My team and I have been driving from county to county to introduce my campaign to folks who may have never heard of me. We’re doing the hard work now - long days, tons of events - so we can meet as many potential voters as possible. I’m especially proud that in recent months I have won nearly all of the straw polls conducted by local Republican organizations across Minnesota. These early victories show that conservatives are ready for a battle-tested leader who will take the fight to Washington and deliver real results for our state. We are on track to win the endorsement of the delegates to the Minnesota Republican Party in May but we need to expand our support now to win in November. We’ve set an ambitious goal of securing 20,000 more conservative endorsements to demonstrate the size and strength of this grassroots movement heading into my August primary. If you can spare just a few moments right now to add your name to my official endorsement list, I hold a Master’s degree from Harvard, advanced training from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA — but my proudest credential remains my service to this country. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey in Minnesota and has never backed down when our nation needed me. In the Senate, I will fight for President Trump’s America First agenda: requiring photo identification to vote in every state, returning to bold budget cutting to save taxpayer dollars, going after corrupt politicians, and restoring law and order. Minnesota deserves a Senator with real courage and proven leadership — not another career politician. A bipartisan push to separate the Office of Child and Family Services from DHHS was rejected, despite claims the current system is overwhelmed and failing. Supporters argue the move could have improved accountability, but Maine Democrats shut it down. As these issues unfold, Jon Fetherston hops in his car mid-stream to report on a developing lockdown situation in Lewiston.

Georgians will cast their ballots by May 19 for multiple seats on the state Supreme Court, which has a critical role to play in defending the freedom to vote and upholding free and fair elections. **We’re proud to endorse two Democracy Champions for the bench: Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin.** They are proven leaders who understand that protecting our rights and our vote means protecting our future. Whether we're talking about voting rights or...access to reproductive healthcare, you name it..._ _“All of these battles and all of these fights in terms of protecting the individual rights of Georgians are going to be fought at the state level.**The people that are on the Supreme Court are really the last line of defense** when it comes to making sure that justice is done and making sure that the rights of the people of this state are protected."_ And take it from Miracle: _**"I believe that corporations, special interests, and the most powerful amongst us don't have more rights than the everyday Georgian...**_ _“But at a time Georgians sense that those rights are being taken away from them and that they are being taken advantage of by powerful special interests, it's important that we understand and that we know that the highest court of our state is actually on our side. clean_body: Help elect Democracy Champions and protect the freedom to vote | | | “'Last line of defense': GA Supreme Court candidates push voter turnout to protect rights”— WGXA News , sometimes elections like this go under the radar. But with your support, we identify races up and down the ballot where this team can make the greatest difference to protect our freedoms. And another one of those opportunities is less than five weeks away. Georgians will cast their ballots by May 19 for multiple seats on the state Supreme Court, which has a critical role to play in defending the freedom to vote and upholding free and fair elections. We’re proud to endorse two Democracy Champions for the bench: Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin. They are proven leaders who understand that protecting our rights and our vote means protecting our future. From fighting for constitutional freedoms to standing up for everyday Georgians, they’re ready to bring fairness and integrity to the bench. And we’re ready to fight alongside them for fair courts and a democracy that works for all Georgians.= Jen and Miracle are running in nonpartisan races against two justices who were originally appointed by a Republican governor. By adding Jen and Miracle’s voices to the Georgia Supreme Court, we’ll shore up our defenses against constant attacks on our freedoms. Take it from Jen: “At the federal level, our rights are gutted. Whether we're talking about voting rights or...access to reproductive healthcare, you name it... “All of these battles and all of these fights in terms of protecting the individual rights of Georgians are going to be fought at the state level.The people that are on the Supreme Court are really the last line of defense when it comes to making sure that justice is done and making sure that the rights of the people of this state are protected." And take it from Miracle: "I believe that corporations, special interests, and the most powerful amongst us don't have more rights than the everyday Georgian... “But at a time Georgians sense that those rights are being taken away from them and that they are being taken advantage of by powerful special interests, it's important that we understand and that we know that the highest court of our state is actually on our side. I'm running to restore the voice of the people of our state and to make sure that they understand that their voices matter just as much as the powerful." Now it’s time to go all out for Jen and Miracle in the last weeks of this election. body:
These major SCOTUS decisions are imminent. How to be ready >> | |
---
Peter, The Supreme Court just issued its notice: Tomorrow they will hand down at least one ruling—and with only six cases left on the docket, we need to be ready to respond. Voting rights. Gun safety. Trans kids’ rights. Dark money in politics. All four hang in the balance. And any one—or several—could be decided TOMORROW. The corrupt MAGA majority is eying these cases to reshape society before the 2026 midterms. One of them, _Louisiana v. Callais_ , **could become one of the most devastating attacks on voting rights in modern history.** Unfortunately, the Supreme Court is extremely secretive. Which means we won’t know which rights will be curtailed tomorrow and which will survive until the next Decision Day—whenever that is. Here’s just a glimpse of what United for Democracy is preparing for, Peter:
* **_Wolford v. Lopez_** _-_ The Court could strike down another commonsense law, this time in Hawaii, **making it harder for states to keep guns out of public spaces.**
* **_United States v. Skrmetti_** _-_ The Court could **uphold bans on trans children from playing sports** with their peers—building on last year's ruling that already stripped healthcare access.
* **_NRSC v. FEC_****-** Another ruling could tear down the few remaining campaign spending limits still in place after _Citizen’s United_ , **letting wealthy donors pour even more money into our elections** through political parties.

While we can’t know which rulings will drop, we do know the MAGA justices have a clear pattern: expanding power for Trump while stripping rights from everyday Americans. We’re watching a Supreme Court on the loose. Stripping rights. Expanding Trump’s power. Daring anyone to stop them. United for Democracy has prepared a coordinated response across media, organizers, and partners nationwide. Whatever rulings drop tomorrow, our allies across civil rights, voting rights, labor, and reproductive justice are ready to act. **This is an all-hands-on-deck moment, and United for Democracy is captaining the ship.** **[Can you chip in $10 today to make sure we have the resources to fight back ahead of tomorrow’s decision day?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsQNarR6PCR1lUtXpWTyhe6lIDH-kzde4dCytvAbrw_E4haMEfCHMCw3yHRTXvGtGrLV2VWNRM8mntfQJPEaV2XJYk7UwvMMi1JgEDJvvp5CMZWon3JIuMm55P1v07o6o0AaZVCdGQnHjFdcvgUsRbzM1GCgyeBtNyj3R16SbEyqyPu3nQk90O-UoSysuWDz7arwAp85R2aN0NaFphxglopP0-SffzjgayGlFLx-EGGyEJQpWpfJqas-no4Nanmv8gGPgdwFxwzhCAYNakzwNQzMGNtQhr--LZJlnyJjUJpb5HAUBjTQ8GgGJCG6uICP5Q/4pu/_b7r9yC_ReGabWrnLw1owg/h0/h001.rSaJPrbkFPsDBD4p2gFFb30OJZagpYPPv2UPp2mg5ug)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Chip in $10 now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsQNarR6PCR1lUtXpWTyhe6lIDH-kzde4dCytvAbrw_E4cfxJnHBN9KYmRWCvDIln2IimsMWpsw65w8gWEvPEM3vdS2AtQ52UYqmgYR9ncs8N9rCM-IRAhlef09R3G6zHRzyFL3ld0EmWUQ7N8LcQroljZbvL5Ajh-tv9iD9geL3bYpB9zcg2i-GBbfXSxhA7T2bo0OmF3EV5rHTFKhYFoUbIDSjLyCyvkoHXKuhaqw2S0jbupWPOoxj1sOBI5UoDPiFTHj54g9HzlbuFlHtHlVmX6LWi2BT3iBpMqjgHlBaL2kJuD3KgHlC6FUTeCYu3PFxU1OBrXm8qziYDzQz_wTas5XU0dkdNSmpsVwrNXFhw/4pu/_b7r9yC_ReGabWrnLw1owg/h1/h001.dyzbo5p_kafWHiKjYPHJu42C0Aurxt4lh2a5HPQhn1E)

clean_body: These major SCOTUS decisions are imminent. How to be ready >> | | Peter, The Supreme Court just issued its notice: Tomorrow they will hand down at least one ruling—and with only six cases left on the docket, we need to be ready to respond. Voting rights. Gun safety. Trans kids’ rights. Dark money in politics. All four hang in the balance. And any one—or several—could be decided TOMORROW. The corrupt MAGA majority is eying these cases to reshape society before the 2026 midterms. One of them, Louisiana v. Callais , could become one of the most devastating attacks on voting rights in modern history. Unfortunately, the Supreme Court is extremely secretive. Which means we won’t know which rights will be curtailed tomorrow and which will survive until the next Decision Day—whenever that is. Here’s just a glimpse of what United for Democracy is preparing for, Peter: Wolford v. Lopez - The Court could strike down another commonsense law, this time in Hawaii, making it harder for states to keep guns out of public spaces. United States v. Skrmetti - The Court could uphold bans on trans children from playing sports with their peers—building on last year's ruling that already stripped healthcare access. NRSC v. FEC**- Another ruling could tear down the few remaining campaign spending limits still in place after Citizen’s United , letting wealthy donors pour even more money into our elections through political parties. While we can’t know which rulings will drop, we do know the MAGA justices have a clear pattern: expanding power for Trump while stripping rights from everyday Americans. We’re watching a Supreme Court on the loose. Stripping rights. Expanding Trump’s power. Daring anyone to stop them. United for Democracy has prepared a coordinated response across media, organizers, and partners nationwide. Whatever rulings drop tomorrow, our allies across civil rights, voting rights, labor, and reproductive justice are ready to act. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment, and United for Democracy is captaining the ship. | | |
---
Hi, Derek,
I don’t think this is controversial: **If you make billions, you shouldn’t pay less in taxes than your secretary.** 🤷
But right now, that’s not how Trump’s tax law works. While people like nurses and firefighters pay taxes straight out of every paycheck, there’s a maze of shady rules and accounting tricks that let the billionaires walk away scot-free while the rest of us pay up.
That’s why I reintroduced the **Billionaires Income Tax Act** , legislation that would close loopholes and ensure billionaires pay their fair share in taxes.
Working Pennsylvanians already face high and rising prices, while billionaires and megacorporations game the system to pay next to nothing in taxes. **This bill is about basic fairness.** ⚖️
**[If you agree it’s time for billionaires to pay their fair share in taxes so we can bring down the debt, keep our promise to seniors on Medicare and Social Security, and cut taxes for working Pennsylvanians, will you add your name now?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53175?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=2&akid=10709%2E434096%2EEiBHva)**

| | Today, OMB Director Russ Vought appeared before the Senate Budget Committee for an oversight hearing, and as Ranking Member of the Committee, I questioned him on Donald Trump's budget. **His answers reinforced what we already knew: this budget is a disaster for working families.****_And I will continue to lead the fight against his families lose, billionaires win budget. I'm a HELL NO._** What we are witnessing is a dangerous attempt to erode Congress' constitutional authority over taxes, spending, and war powers. **The Constitution is unambiguous: Congress controls the power of the purse.** Yet Trump's administration has repeatedly disregarded that — from illegally impounding funds, to using procedural tricks to bypass Congress, to undermining federal agencies and workers who are responsible for delivering basic services. And now, that same approach defines this budget. Trump’s budget proposal is another proposal where families lose and billionaires win. It does nothing to lower the cost of groceries or gas, it ignores our long-term fiscal challenges like rising national debt, and it offers no serious plan to protect programs like Social Security and Medicare that millions rely on. Instead, Trump's budget pours an eye-popping $1.5 trillion into the Pentagon, while continuing to spend billions on his reckless war in Iran — putting our servicemembers at risk and driving up costs here at home. For decades, presidents of both parties have submitted detailed budgets outlining long-term plans for taxes, debt, and the future of essential programs. This proposal does none of that.**It prioritizes more spending on weapons and war while cutting investments in housing, health care, education, infrastructure, scientific research, and environmental protection.** **It's not a serious plan. It's another part of Trump's MAGA agenda that puts billionaires and defense corporations ahead of working families.** I'm going to keep fighting in the Senate to reject this budget and push for real solutions that make life more affordable and expand opportunity for all. Former Democratic Virginia Lieutenant Governor Justin Fairfax and his wife Cerina were found dead in their home early Thursday[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae8602f-48e0-4f7a-8694-14364993f099?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[in an apparent murder-suicide amid a messy divorce, authorities confirmed.](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae8602f-48e0-4f7a-8694-14364993f099?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* **Messy Divorce Trigger:** The incident followed Justin being recently served papers for an upcoming court proceeding in what police described as a complicated or messy divorce that apparently led to this event.
* **Children Home During Tragedy:** The couple's two teenage children were in the home during the murder-suicide with one child making the 911 call after midnight to report the traumatic event they witnessed.
* **Prior Domestic Incident:** In January police responded to Justin's allegation of assault by Cerina but house cameras showed the alleged assault never occurred investigators confirmed from the footage collected.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7094e419-886b-489f-bd27-9b6b460a009f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Cartridge Case Identified:** Investigators confirmed the recovered cartridge case bearing a Remington headstamp was fired in the Exhibit 1 rifle tied to Robinson providing key linkage to the alleged murder weapon recovered near the scene.
* **Defense Strategy Setback:** While the damaged bullet jacket fragment could not be conclusively linked or excluded from the rifle the new details make it more difficult for Robinson's team to argue he did not fire the fatal shot.

##### **APRIL 16, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #4**
## **My fellow patriots of District 11, my fellow Floridians, my fellow Americans --**
If you have ever stood at the edge of a grove at dawn and watched the mist rise off the trees, you know something that no bureaucrat in Washington will ever understand.
This land is not a line item on a federal register. It is not a coordinate on a map. It is a promise--between generations, between neighbors, between the sweat you pour into the soil and the fruit it gives back.
I raised my children in that promise. I know what it means to draw water from the ground, to tend what God gave you, and to trust that the work of your hands will feed your family and fund your retirement. That promise is under siege--not by drought or storm, but by a system that treats your birthright as its jurisdiction.
This dispatch is not a complaint. It is a briefing--critical, actionable intelligence from the front lines of a fight that most of our neighbors don't even know is happening. And it begins with a confession from the man sworn to represent us.
Daniel Webster's own website contains a confession he hopes you'll never read:
_**" My staff is happy to ask for information or a status report on a pending case, or ask for clarification on the reasons for denial, but it would be inappropriate for me to compel any agency to decide an issue in your favor, or attempt to overturn a decision that is final."**_
Read that again.
Your congressman--the man sworn to represent you--has declared that he cannot override agency decisions. He cannot compel agencies to decide in your favor. He cannot overturn final decisions.
For fifteen years, he has presided over a system he admits he cannot change. He waters the leaves while the root rot consumes our foundation.
His newsletters celebrate "constituent services" that help you navigate the bureaucracy. He brags about returning $3.6 million that the government already owed you. But when the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) classifies your pasture as a federal wetland by letter--when the Army Corps of Engineers denies your water permit--when the Southwest Florida Water Management District (SWFWMD) restricts your right to draw water from your own land--what does Daniel Webster do?
He asks for a status report. He asks for clarification. He does not strike the root.
This is an assault on the pillar of **Environmental Security** --your right to steward your own land and water. It is equally an assault on **Familial and Economic Security** --your ability to build a life, pass down an inheritance, and work your property without arbitrary federal confiscation.
* * *
## **The Impact: A Drought of Justice in District 11**
In Polk County, a farmer opens a letter from the Army Corps declaring his pasture a federal wetland under the Waters of the United States (WOTUS) rule. He cannot build. He cannot farm. He cannot sell. His congressman's office will send an inquiry and ask for clarification.
In Lake County, a citrus grower faces St. Johns River Water Management District (SJRWMD) nutrient loading mandates that restrict how he can manage his own grove. The water management district acts as prosecutor, judge, and jury. His congressman will ask for a status report.
In Sumter County, the Withlacoochee River watershed falls under SWFWMD Minimum Flows and Levels (MFLs) that restrict water withdrawal from private land. The agency that sets the MFLs is the same agency that enforces it. His congressman cannot overturn that decision.
In Orange County, the Econlockhatchee River watershed sits under WOTUS designations that turn drainage ditches into federal waterways. Permits are delayed or denied by the Army Corps--an agency that investigates, prosecutes, and judges its own cases. His congressman cannot compel them to decide in your favor.
Meanwhile, Webster's latest newsletter celebrates securing funding for Clermont stormwater infrastructure, Polk City wastewater improvements, and Wildwood wastewater capacity upgrades. These are appropriations for pipes and treatment plants--good things. But the same federal government he's funding is classifying your pasture as a wetland by letter. He funds the pipes while the agencies poison your property rights.
This is not representation. It is managed surrender.
The erosion of Environmental Security directly undermines Familial Security--when the government can declare your pasture a wetland by decree, your family's inheritance is not yours to pass down. It undermines Economic Security--when a permit denial can turn productive land into worthless dust, your livelihood is subject to bureaucratic whim.
* * *
## **The Strategy: The Administrative Independence Act**
The founder's mandate is clear. Alexander Hamilton, in defending the Constitution, called the jury trial a "valuable privilege" and our security against corruption. We must restore it. James Madison warned of the "double security" provided to the rights of the people by the separation of powers within government and between state and federal authority. Today, that security is gone. The administrative state has consolidated the power to make rules, enforce them, and judge their violation into a single, unaccountable entity.
**Our strike is the Administrative Independence Act.**
This Act will abolish the internal courts of agencies like the EPA and the Army Corps. It will force every dispute--every WOTUS designation, every wetlands fine, every permit denial--into a neutral, Article III federal court, with a jury of your peers.
**This is not about discarding science or inviting pollution; it is about demanding proof and protecting rights.** The current system doesn't protect the environment; it protects the agency. It grants a monopoly on truth to unelected experts who face no consequence for error or overreach. Our plan protects both--our shared resources and our sacred rights--by restoring the Founders' central guard against corruption: the common sense of a jury of your peers. **A government that is right should not fear a fair trial.**
While Daniel Webster says he cannot compel an agency to decide in your favor, the Administrative Independence Act says: you won't have to. That agency will face you in a court of law, before a jury of your peers, where your congressman's helplessness is irrelevant because the Constitution itself is your defense.
By restoring our right to a real day in court, we simultaneously secure the Environmental, Familial, and Economic pillars--**because a government that can be sued is a government that must act in good faith.**
The drought of justice ends when we restore the jury box. This is how the strike solves our water crisis: it does not adjudicate science, but it arrests the power of agencies to act with impunity. By forcing every designation and denial to be defended before a jury of citizens, it replaces the certainty of administrative overreach with the sobering test of public justification. It changes the incentive from control to proof.
* * *

But when an agency can unilaterally determine the fate of your property by letter, that method--and your sovereignty--is nullified.
This battle plan does not ask you to become a lawyer. It asks you to become a **witness for your own defense** and a **source for your own liberation.**
Empowerment begins when you transform your private grievance into public evidence. When you gather the letter, note the date, and write down the cost, you are doing more than documenting an injustice. You are building the first link in a chain that can bind the administrative state. You are converting your story from a closed case file into a weapon for reform.
Your evidence, combined with that of your neighbors, creates the undeniable, collective proof that the system is broken. It moves the debate from abstract policy to human consequence. It compels not just an inquiry, but an answer.
**Join me in this endeavor --**
**One: Gather Your Evidence.** Locate any Waters of the United States (WOTUS) determination letter, wetlands classification notice, permit denial, or enforcement action you have received from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), the Army Corps of Engineers, Southwest Florida Water Management District (SWFWMD), or St. Johns River Water Management District (SJRWMD). Pull the document. Find the date. Note the agency. Note whether you were offered a jury trial.
**Two: Personalize The Cost.** Write down--in your own words--how this federal or state action affected your family, your land, your livelihood, or your inheritance. What did you lose? What could you not build? What was taken from you by decree--not by a jury of your peers?

Every submission becomes part of the evidentiary case we will carry to Washington. Daniel Webster confesses he cannot compel an agency. In Congress, I will use the evidence we gather not to plead with agencies, but to compel my colleagues to restore your constitutional right to a jury trial.
* * *
## **Forward, Always**
Daniel Webster asks for clarification from the agency. I will abolish their internal courts.
He requests status reports. I will force them into real courts.
He presides over confiscation. I will restore the Constitution.

The contrast is absolute: between a congressman who confesses he cannot help you, and a champion who will structure the system so you don't need his help--because the Seventh Amendment will be your shield.
Strike the root. Secure the table.
Forward, always--

**Peter, this is Lt. General Mike Flynn. I need your eyes on this _right now._** I’m sending a **warning message** to every America First patriot— _because what happens in this upcoming Governor’s race will decide the future of our movement._ **Peter** , I know what it’s like to fight for my life. I know what it's like to be politically persecuted. **So does Nancy Mace.** **[Before I explain why I’m endorsing her for Governor, I want to tell you about her.](https://secure.winred.com/nancy-mace-for-governor//pkg1047-ag3739-email-eml-fls?xuna=v1%3AeyJhZ3kiOiIwMjkiLCJhc2siOiIwMDEiLCJjbGkiOiIwODciLCJpc3MiOiIwMDEiLCJtZWQiOiJlbWFpbCIsInBrZyI6IlBLRzEwNDciLCJzdXIiOiIwMDAiLCJ3byI6IkFHMzczOSJ9&recurring=true&amount=26&xuno=464c3330383633&utm_medium=email&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02009801)** **At 17, Nancy dropped out of high school. ** She didn’t come from a silver-spoon background. Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

This week, we submitted nearly 30,000 petition signatures to officially

**National Republicans are coming for New Hampshire.**
While Democrats are working hard to flip seats in North Carolina and Ohio, Republicans are looking for a way to cancel out our gains.
**We can’t give them an inch.**
_But Donald Trump and Senate Republicans see New Hampshire as their best pick-up opportunity_ — and they’re putting real money behind that strategy.
**[Before I share more, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can right now to give our campaign the leg up we need to fight back against the wave of GOP money coming our way?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260416_3.G-PqFH&refcode=em20260416-3&t=2&akid=6155%2E582294%2EmlEhfM)**

Republicans simply wouldn’t make that kind of commitment if they didn’t believe this race in New Hampshire could decide control of the Senate.
That’s why this grassroots-powered campaign matters so much.

If we hold here, we protect Democrats’ path to flipping the Senate. If we don’t, that path becomes _a whole lot harder._

body:
Radical Democrats just surged in Minnesota. National extremists are pouring in millions to flip our state. | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=64a2cd9832ef4c99855c1e88a8253638&_e=WEHFBhMWOOzpFAdL2T9_Q-WQ_AhIGj8TspBIzK9fYCxUNciUaq2qZAqQrgb9UX_6DW3rBFqK_Y-bwUcRPEcD7AB7cnPQBDmY5_iY7TS6d-taNwDqXQuvvOObSWE3hSlKCBtWLzJy56wRyELh8nIFguDzhMZisfcXW-q3da9N0DOakKX3FsxE8SlRg-K0cCIbsK3OwFBR0ERN76XF0cjojCt6ilO476m4wavAjSNIjS9zNc53z3k65rIc_c3hPO_zTYQk-Wn1siiJtFNud0Z4T4z606osp0KfHHK-4Pnj-NU2YkJIdBujTWlBmgSfBZxZaqB9Zl4HoICe0Q9rJRkaWLesLiv3c2pw03YW1vZRoiJrQmdgFTsvQ2QuMHYzjC-iUsHkLZgXi1--C7QX2gcEFlPj7r5bAF1IcFomzQxBlyAPlhv8uSHRTZ9Lhli_xcSPoTrdxJwimVebeNtujjHmsyulg4FTD41P1vOKC_ZxqZzpLMsjAhhIkzGxj7RK7umhnl85j0K6SkUR_Ae0jY0r8liHhf3eJrfUTsVZnnWGFUll8lGfSS6usyBvfGKPgwiaCJ6JhAdBjzF69iVDAib8UY8nh9Bbk7d2RPjcmgrtH1OPE_oJpIBSH7sGd-8Vz5T5kB-ADCvsottJGUKqsvu84XpKZjs0HXj2MB2_ff0hA5goiKMz-bc7V-1lzBjns9eiQd9xnvalkPxIxZq3lhcAYKVnaxAxN-KC3__o6p9LzMDAT_av6FoTEvMlKse2HACB)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers.

250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today.

That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL.** I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love.

Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — _**the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable.**_
**_
Just take a look at the photo below: _**

_[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=64a2cd9832ef4c99855c1e88a8253638&_e=WEHFBhMWOOzpFAdL2T9_Q-WQ_AhIGj8TspBIzK9fYCxUNciUaq2qZAqQrgb9UX_6DW3rBFqK_Y-bwUcRPEcD7AB7cnPQBDmY5_iY7TS6d-taNwDqXQuvvOObSWE3hSlKCBtWLzJy56wRyELh8nIFguDzhMZisfcXW-q3da9N0DOakKX3FsxE8SlRg-K0cCIbsK3OwFBR0ERN76XF0cjojCt6ilO476m4wavAjSNIjS9zNc53z3k65rIc_c3hPO_zTYQk-Wn1siiJtFNud0Z4TwoWMphSrFZxunvOF8kWkaOiXn4P76xZsZ7_QQic6arRG3ovMmJggmipme-LNpi-78XC_cDm5MMfCZ7h0OG0oXPKCeRyubu5kvgQ3llh5lW95EtWKwo2RQjv2UyeNeFf3x8XHQULjY0lwWPlnzXAisZQE5gUOxUNnbT5P-87utcLept5joGkPwRALBfRcy4Q-R9b4Z1keFPtsRcZJ5xSgRw0jd2v7DymPcx9MU6vstRRtDLjsGJpsS5AbO7ja6-PbD2MuOgHpiSXkRlBAgDtylfIb5Vz_l922YKyBF34DMqUVTSovSYVM9EEft4LVp2DUxKakgUIOs9wTo7V4WGrJs1VsUe44UYk8OXRpZuVrCMZOAsmhJureu0ThQmGiU4LDPi70uuA5PzHobUjFLKnZDjm3BZc_DVsp709DVO_VbVXmHXfxl75R8a8RsJ6cM_5mySSPm5fmgzxvQXP4IaMG2JGSXmgPuCvvqCVREdvt711)_
This is Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, she’s my main opponent in this race. You can see here she is cosplaying as a Somali Muslim. It smells exactly like another Elizabeth Warren — cultural appropriation at its most cynical, and we don’t need another radical like that representing Minnesota in the United States Senate.

That is not the Minnesota I grew up in — playing hockey in a working-class family and learning to love this country. **It’s not the America I risked my life to defend across nine deployments. And it’s not the future any of us want for our children as we head toward America’s 250th birthday.**

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m not a career politician. _**By Eric Lullove, DPM, Blue Amp Media Medical Contributing Editor**_
Let me be direct with you. When I started pulling on this thread--what I expected to find was a bureaucratic procurement story about government contractors. **What I found instead was something considerably more unsettling: a layered, interlocking surveillance architecture operating inside the US healthcare system that most clinicians, administrators, and even healthcare attorneys have never seen mapped in its entirety.**
This piece is the first half of my attempt to do that mapping.
What follows examines how Palantir Technologies--a company born from Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) seed funding and best known for helping Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) track undocumented immigrants--has embedded itself at virtually every level of the federal health infrastructure: from hospital operating rooms to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to the immigration enforcement apparatus.
In Part 2, I will map the other side of this architecture: the Medicare audit contractor ecosystem--the Unified Program Integrity Contractor (UPIC), Recovery Audit Contractor (RAC), Targeted Probe and Educate (TPE), and Wasteful and Inappropriate Service Reduction (WISeR) programs that govern your billing compliance--and show how these two systems are converging into something none of us voted for.

_Photo by Brett Sayles / Pexels (free license). Server racks in a data center --the physical layer of the surveillance infrastructure described in this article._
# How Deep Does It Go?
The question I set out to answer was deceptively simple: how extensively has Palantir Technologies penetrated US healthcare data systems? The answer, documented through federal procurement records and investigative reporting, is: comprehensively.
Start at the hospital level. Palantir has signed Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) contracts with Cleveland Clinic, Tampa General Hospital, HCA Healthcare, and Option Care Health, deploying its AIP software for patient flow optimization, staffing, and supply chain management.[[1]](https://substack.com/redirect/f9ba43a8-9040-4171-a749-f90f7d9da8cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Healthcare now accounts for 15 percent of Palantir's commercial revenue--a line of business that generated $702 million in 2024.[[2]](https://substack.com/redirect/55801584-34ab-4436-ad18-8a023503b7af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The company has been transparent about its strategy: create operational dependency. Multiyear contracts at institutions like Tampa General have progressed to AI-driven revenue cycle management, meaning hospitals are not simply purchasing software. They are restructuring their financial operations around Palantir's infrastructure.
But the hospital-level presence is the visible layer. The federal layer is where this becomes structurally significant.
In 2022, HHS signed a five-year, $90 million blanket purchase agreement with Palantir--the SHARE contract (Solutioning with Holistic Analytics Restructured for the Enterprise)--making Palantir's Foundry platform available to every HHS agency through a single procurement vehicle.[[3]](https://substack.com/redirect/cfa71b24-47bc-450c-814d-1ca73151d933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The National Institutes of Health (NIH), the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and CMS can all access Foundry without separate competitive bidding. That is not a contract. That is infrastructure.
The downstream agency penetration is documented. NIH uses Foundry. CDC used it during the pandemic for data analytics. FDA has deployed it. And in June 2024, the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) awarded Palantir a separate $19 million, two-year contract to serve as its core data infrastructure--to "rapidly collect, synthesize, analyze, and make decisions from a range of data sources."[[4]](https://substack.com/redirect/5715d765-d3c3-49e9-85cf-295d3674964b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At CMS specifically, federal spending records show Palantir received awards for a "national provider directory--proof of concept," positioning it as a potential backbone for a unified federal database of every healthcare provider in the United States. That project, formally the National Directory of Healthcare Providers and Services, has been in development for years. Palantir is now among the finalists for its architecture.[[5]](https://substack.com/redirect/2b98ed55-c5ee-4203-b3c1-00f11811dce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### _Palantir 's core value proposition to the government is connecting databases that were never meant to be connected._
# The Cross-Program Data Fusion Problem
The most alarming documented concern in this space is not what Palantir does within any single agency. It is what happens at the seams between agencies.
The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) has documented that ICE used Palantir's ELITE tool to access Medicaid enrollment records from HHS.[[6]](https://substack.com/redirect/92013d66-1d20-4da1-a38d-ea2dcfb02b47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Read that again carefully: the immigration enforcement apparatus used a healthcare data platform to identify and locate individuals enrolled in the Medicaid program. A healthcare safety-net database, collected for the explicit purpose of administering medical benefits to low-income patients, was operationalized as a deportation tool.
This is not an allegation. It is documented. Palantir has denied building this functionality explicitly, but the EFF's findings and subsequent investigative reporting from _The Intercept_ and leaked ICE procurement documents tell a consistent story:[[7]](https://substack.com/redirect/739a9646-f3b3-4798-8f15-d7cb1fdfb21b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palantir's software is architected to eliminate the walls between databases that were built to be separate. Medicaid data merging with immigration records. Tax returns merging with law enforcement databases. Passport data merging with cell phone location records.

Each individual dataset was collected legitimately, for a specific statutory purpose, with specific legal restrictions on its use. Palantir's Foundry eliminates those restrictions operationally by making cross-database queries trivially executable. The legal walls remain. The technical walls do not.
In New York City, the Health and Hospitals Corporation paid Palantir nearly $4 million between 2023 and 2026 to improve billing efficiency for Medicaid and other public benefits--including automated scanning of patient clinical notes to "increase charges captured from missed opportunities."[[8]](https://substack.com/redirect/d873df66-0015-424f-b53f-eae8e93124fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) When this arrangement was publicly disclosed by _The Intercept_ in February 2026, the hospital system's CEO defended it by citing an "absolute firewall" between patient data and Palantir's government customers. The contract was not renewed after community outcry.[[9]](https://substack.com/redirect/6212d28a-0d36-4e12-ab56-489f040653da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I want to dwell on what that NYC contract actually was: a clinical AI system reading physician notes and flagging underbilled services, operating inside a public hospital system that also has contractual relationships with a company whose software ICE uses to find people. Whether those data streams were actually connected is almost secondary. The architecture that would permit such a connection was in place.
That is the appropriate unit of analysis when evaluating surveillance infrastructure: not what data is flowing right now, but what data _could_ flow given the systems that have been deployed.
This is the infrastructure layer. In Part 2, I will map the audit contractor ecosystem that sits on top of it--the UPIC, RAC, and WISeR programs, their private equity ownership chains, and the contingency-fee incentive structures that shape how your claims are reviewed. These are not separate stories. They are the same story. And the system is scaling.

body:
DHS is illegally targeting, detaining, and deporting DACA recipients. We’ll keep fighting back. | | | Peter,
In our ongoing series this month, we’ll explain, point by point, the threats DACA recipients are currently facing. Here are the words of one DACA recipient, whose brother — also a DACA recipient — has been detained since November1: _“I’ve been so nervous, to be honest with you, even with my DACA that I have right now that came in the mail a month and a half ago. I just feel like I’m not safe like I used to, that at any time they could come and take it away from me, and then I have nowhere else to go.”_ DACA was meant to protect immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But the administration is trying to undermine DACA by urging DACA recipients to self-deport, and actively ignoring the protections from detention and deportation that DACA guarantees. What’s more, there has been _specific targeting_ of DACA recipients in enforcement actions. Federal immigration agencies have launched targeted operations to arrest and detain DACA recipients who have valid status. In addition, there are news reports of TSA providing travel information directly to enforcement agencies, which have used the information to target immigrants at airports, including immigrant college students traveling domestically.2 Additionally, the administration has indefinitely halted all immigration applications from 39 countries3 — including DACA renewals for more than 3,280 recipients. That means their legal status can lapse, making them even more vulnerable to detention and deportation. **DACA recipients — our coworkers, friends, neighbors, and classmates — are continuing to be detained and cruelly separated from their families.****We will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country.** ******[We need your help fueling our advocacy efforts. clean_body: DHS is illegally targeting, detaining, and deporting DACA recipients. We’ll keep fighting back. | | | Peter, In our ongoing series this month, we’ll explain, point by point, the threats DACA recipients are currently facing. Here are the words of one DACA recipient, whose brother — also a DACA recipient — has been detained since November1: “I’ve been so nervous, to be honest with you, even with my DACA that I have right now that came in the mail a month and a half ago. I just feel like I’m not safe like I used to, that at any time they could come and take it away from me, and then I have nowhere else to go.” DACA was meant to protect immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But the administration is trying to undermine DACA by urging DACA recipients to self-deport, and actively ignoring the protections from detention and deportation that DACA guarantees. What’s more, there has been specific targeting of DACA recipients in enforcement actions. Federal immigration agencies have launched targeted operations to arrest and detain DACA recipients who have valid status. In addition, there are news reports of TSA providing travel information directly to enforcement agencies, which have used the information to target immigrants at airports, including immigrant college students traveling domestically.2 Additionally, the administration has indefinitely halted all immigration applications from 39 countries3 — including DACA renewals for more than 3,280 recipients. That means their legal status can lapse, making them even more vulnerable to detention and deportation. DACA recipients — our coworkers, friends, neighbors, and classmates — are continuing to be detained and cruelly separated from their families.We will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country. **** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | In the face of these challenges, we know that the power for real change rests with us — the people. We know that the strength and resilience of our communities can create a future where we can all thrive. We’re here, we’re organizing, and we’re facing this moment together. — Nico, United We Dream * 1. “ICE Is Detaining DACA Recipients. It’s Growing Harder for Them to Get Out.” NOTUS. April 10, 2026. 2. “Immigration Agents Are Using Air Passenger Data for Deportation Effort.” The New York Times. #
My dear supporters,

Please read the press release attached below that went out today.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart. You are the ones who make our campaign fundraising success possible. I appreciate your believing in me and our campaign messages.

We have many challenges ahead against a well funded Goodlander campaign, but in America, anything is possible. We will continue pushing ahead to build our grassroots army for the American Dream.

With deep gratitude,

\------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
Contact: Michael Biundo
[michael@ascent-strategic.com](mailto:michael@ascent-strategic.com)
April 16, 2026
Weare, New Hampshire

**LILY TANG WILLIAMS ANNOUNCES STRONG Q1 FUNDRAISING HAUL, CONTINUING RECORD MOMENTUM AS LEADING REPUBLICAN IN NH-02**

**Weare, NH** – Lily Tang Williams, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District, today announced another impressive fundraising quarter, raising $212,171 in the first quarter of 2026.

This brings her total raised to date to $869,483, with $573,959 cash on hand.

"New Hampshire families are fired up and ready to take back our district,” said Williams. “This robust Q1 performance builds directly on the momentum from last quarter and our record-breaking 2025 totals. It shows the grassroots energy behind our campaign and proves that voters are rejecting the status quo in Washington. As the strongest Republican in this race, we are well-funded, well-organized, and laser-focused on flipping NH-02 red in November.”

**“Lily Tang Williams is proving something important in New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District: when you speak plainly about the issues that actually affect working families, the support follows — and it follows fast,”** said Michael Biundo, Partner at Ascent Strategic. “Her continued fundraising prowess this quarter demonstrates why she is the clear grassroots leader and strongest Republican in the NH-02 race.”

Williams’ impressive Q1 results — achieved with **zero PAC money** , unlike her opponent — underscore her prowess as a Republican challenger in one of New England’s most competitive districts. Powered almost entirely by small-dollar donors from across New Hampshire and the country, her campaign has consistently outperformed expectations. This latest quarter keeps her on track to mount a formidable challenge against incumbent Democrat Maggie Goodlander while expanding her grassroots network and volunteer army.

A survivor of Mao’s Cultural Revolution who arrived in America with just $100, Williams embodies the American Dream she is fighting to preserve. Soon after arriving, she met her future husband John; they have been happily married for 35 years and are the proud parents of three adult children. As a small business owner and proven conservative fighter, she is committed to delivering results on border security, lower taxes, energy independence, and fiscal responsibility.
With substantial cash on hand and growing momentum, the campaign is poised for an aggressive push through the primary and into the general election.

For more information about her campaign, visit [www.lilytangwilliams.com](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=d356025e34&e=c338950e03). **Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee** ### \------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

body:
What I keep coming back to is this:
#
Peter,
Over the past few months, I’ve spent a lot of time listening, reflecting, and thinking about what this moment demands of us.
What I keep coming back to is this: people are looking for leadership that shows up, tells the truth, and is willing to fight for what matters.
I know a little bit about that.
I’ve run in tough places. I’ve won in tough places. I’ve represented communities that don’t always fit neatly into the boxes political consultants like to use. **REPORT: BILL CASSIDY MELTING DOWN OVER LACK OF SUPPORT**
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — A new [report](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=c15a475aec&e=95355a072c) from The Daily Caller reveals that Senator Bill Cassidy melted down over not getting enough help from the National Republican Senatorial Committee, and was called out by the NRSC’s executive director for voting to convict President Trump.
**Trump-Impeaching GOP Senator Reportedly Melted Down Over Not Getting Enough Money**
A GOP senator who voted to convict President Donald Trump accused the Republican establishment of not pouring enough money into his already cash-rich reelection campaign, Punchbowl News reported Friday.
Republican Louisiana Sen. Bill Cassidy is set to face voters for the first time since his vote following Trump’s second impeachment, as he competes against Louisiana Rep. Julia Letlow and Louisiana Treasurer John Fleming in a brutal May 16 GOP primary. Despite spending millions of dollars in his bid for a third term, Cassidy lashed out at the National Republican Senatorial Committee (NRSC) in a phone call, accusing the Senate Republicans’ campaign arm of not sufficiently funding his campaign, according to Punchbowl News.
NRSC Executive Director Jennifer DeCasper gave a profanity-laced response to the embattled senator, stating that he should not have joined Democrats and six other GOP senators in convicting Trump in February 2021, the outlet reported, citing multiple anonymous sources.
The committee has released video ads supporting Cassidy. Its chairman, Republican South Carolina Sen. Tim Scott, endorsed his campaign along with Senate Majority Leader John Thune. Peter, Arizona lawmakers are advancing two dangerous bills that would fundamentally change who has political power in the state. These bills are a desperate attempt to silence communities, weaken fair representation, and waste taxpayer dollars on an unnecessary state census. Here’s the gist:
* SCR 1023 imposes an unnecessarily low cap on how much district populations can vary, making it harder to represent Arizona’s diverse communities fairly. **The bill would reduce representation for everyday people, prioritizing political power over democracy.**
* SCR 1031 goes even further. It’ll erase fair representation for hundreds of thousands of Arizona residents by excluding non-citizens, temporary residents, and undocumented immigrants from census population counts.**Inaccurate population counts will result in distorted representation, fewer resources, and less political power for certain communities.**

Peter, we've seen this playbook before. When politicians manipulate who gets counted, political power moves away from urban, diverse, and immigrant communities and toward whiter, wealthier, and more rural and suburban ones. clean_body: We need your support to defend every Arizonan’s right to be represented. | Peter, Arizona lawmakers are advancing two dangerous bills that would fundamentally change who has political power in the state. These bills are a desperate attempt to silence communities, weaken fair representation, and waste taxpayer dollars on an unnecessary state census. Here’s the gist: SCR 1023 imposes an unnecessarily low cap on how much district populations can vary, making it harder to represent Arizona’s diverse communities fairly. The bill would reduce representation for everyday people, prioritizing political power over democracy. SCR 1031 goes even further. It’ll erase fair representation for hundreds of thousands of Arizona residents by excluding non-citizens, temporary residents, and undocumented immigrants from census population counts.Inaccurate population counts will result in distorted representation, fewer resources, and less political power for certain communities. Senate Blocks Iran War Powers

The Senate voted 52-47 on Wednesday to [block a Democratic war powers resolution](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuwyAUAL_G3rAAYxMPDF28pWtH6-XxbKNgQEBKP79KP6HzSXfSfd23OzjvwvEJF5lc981Gu-2uQKZADXw5Y7OxhSdc4GGTXM6MKybmLeVYEmHdRG-NRQsCezJC63m8Ca5Efxq-q8mKabHjvAhQXIppetwQtdCKjyR6Z95CrsQsR8HHZUAc9Q1nxEVwDTt0ioOnXIdM6fXwDiFUKM89ZqQB49V7c9aaSjd-dHLt5NpaG_b4E6iVN-_kmqJ31WHp5HrExM7obWE1v67EXIbAGmSGGfBZGF2UD2KWwHoXiAWCXPpsbGrOe1dm3Sl-XOD8X7v-e9i3kb8BAAD__3_Zf5c) that would have constrained President Trump's military campaign against Iran--the fourth consecutive rejection of such a measure since the conflict began six weeks ago. Trump declared the war "very close to over" in a [Fox News interview](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LGO4yAQgOGnwV0sBgiOC4pr3OXaK60xMyQo2FjAhX38VfYRtv6lr_j_3dc7xhSPx1_c2ZUWVsq0hlix8MEdU33mTrkfL9wx4aqkshdpLmDXs-R6sm8rDOTIE4If2ME0WX0DaWB4upmvWhERzqy8MZulaQO_aYOBbhxgiO4DSgNWaZB6Hr3X081b72eQEwYURmLi0sbC5_8tRY9Hw_oKuXgefd6H5J6tnVXoP0ItQi299zHkr4N7_XShlnckzkItVs8arqCsAVBDcXT2mFKsdhJGPnaM6Qdsv77wduo7AAD__5wXbm4), as Pakistan prepared to host a second round of direct U.S.-Iran negotiations. The two-week ceasefire expires April 22, and the White House said it feels "good about prospects of a deal." Sen. Rand Paul, R-Kentucky, was the lone Republican yes vote; Sen. John Fetterman, D-Pennsylvania, sided with Republicans against it. The measure, sponsored by Sen. Tammy Duckworth, D-Illinois, would have required congressional authorization for continued offensive military operations, per [The Hill](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAYBOCngY0IsM3vDAxdvKVrR-sP_I5RsEFAyutX6dAH6HynT7r7uq03DDGcj088yJa2rT75dQsVC53UMdY9dZ_6-cQDI65aaiPkKJRZc0k1k2ur4t5651E5TlYBmGFWclR8twjea2PwjhrlRhvAZEBJRFCA0zTyYN-gHJXRg5LD9eLcALMzzl2VBNyQjRIjlXYplF_3GByeDetzS8XRxaWDR7u3lisbPphemF7aTnuI8Z0xvezpeM-oTC-VTmzE9DLNg4brLFp5HVmEgqfoWEROnUoVfzVerM89xBiqATbKx4Hhl-Xt3z99W_0TAAD___vGewU). ★★★
Big Beautiful Bill Meets Reality

Republicans spent Tax Day touting the [One Big Beautiful Bill Act's tax savings](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHO4yAQhJ_G7rAA-7edguIad7n2SmuzLAkKBsSSkMc_OY_wtzOj0cz377pfwQcf73_hIFOq222yu_MMhSI1CPxIzaYWn3BAgF1LPQs5CTXvuSTOhHVXvTUWLSjsyahlmcdVyUn1DwOonJslgparlvjz4xayelXawSJHdeu9OQvlpGY9KjleBsRxWXFGvCi5gINukhCo1KFQft2CR4gV-OlSQRowHX0wj1ozd-OfTm-d3lprg0ufSI1Pv9NbTsFXj9zpzX2vCktgg48k7imLWwCuLCwdCQtUFinnxGeslteRRYWPwFdlccDzVIN3JOiTKbJ_U1-Mzc2H4HleukneD_DhO6z-mubb6P8BAAD__yySjBw), only to find voters more focused on surging gas prices and the Iran war undercutting much of that relief. The legislation permanently extended the 2017 individual tax cuts and eliminated taxes on tips and overtime. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and press secretary Karoline Leavitt headlined a [Tax Day White House briefing](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O3SAUhJ8Gd1j8BdsFRRp3mzaldQwHGy0GC9jLzdtHTpV629E3o9H3-2P7gBBDOn7BhaY0v7nsNh8qFEzYIdYzd5d7-oQLImyCCU2Zolxvd8n1Rts2PjjjrANuBzR8mrScOVN8OA2TXPh5UqCl2_XiEWG3C2NWSe1xkUMwzyBTXAvJmVxGa-U0W23twtkEHohiELG0seD9tcdgITWonz4Xi6PN1xDN2dpdifxJxErE2nsfO9QzpKPlhG-4QsLyoESsCXt9mDM0pGf-qkjEqn6IZebzk0OzJ43hhTQivEJrdMdaMTX6X4XeBWulewnoQzpogzd18IeIdSjG3T3EGKqeiGLHBSH-e9m-rfZlxN8AAAD__0m6jpY) zeroing in on how the bill is changing filing season for Americans. The problem: gas prices tied to the Iran war are erasing those gains for many households, turning a would-be political win into a midterm headache. The RNC chair, pressed on the crunch, [told the Daily Caller](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL3O4yAURJ8Gd0T8BTsFxTbusu2W1s3l2kbBBgGJk7dfeZvtv26kkWaOzp_7dIcQw778ho1cafPkk5_mUKHQTgfEuqbDp2N_wgYRJiWU5cJwaadcUs2EbZKddx49SOzIyb63epDCyG51V2MHMyBp1ApvRs1-kL0ETWLorbrKLrhzUBhplZZC3y6Iuh_QIt6k6GEGZgREKu1SKL8eMSDsDepzTgXpgmnroltby5XpX0yNTI0eQvwixEjl7JkazwemRmGYGuWZ6IPxVcObeNmR4wqh8CVlnqG0L2_lG_aFt8Tn8OG5pEekjbcVGl8hZ9rJ8_8wvJUwEzZgauyK8_kIMYZqe2bEskGI_yDbj82-nfobAAD__5HijEE) the conflict would yield "long-term gain for the country." ★★★
FISA Revolt Stalls Johnson

Speaker Mike Johnson [canceled a House floor vote](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFyrCAYBeCnwU4HEEELitvY7W1TMv_-4EoWwQEiefyMeYTUZ-Y7c87HwzzABx9f_-FwOtfN2GTN5gtkF12DUPbUbGrxDQcEMJxy2VPRM2nOnMrpsBrWWW3RAsPOaaaUHGdGBet2LeQk6GblxKZ5gXFRSknJnpOSSGekS-f1DVLBJB8ZHZcBcVQzSsSFUQUbEEEhuFyH7M6vZ_AIsUJ5bymjGzAdXdB7rWch4z_CV8LX1toA3z6VOyV8vX3CVyoIX9lE-Hr4t-s_0x5Liv09tMcUi8sXVH-5Prsrhdplbc_mQ_BFKiLo6wAffvvqn0-6NP8JAAD__-ZneFw) Wednesday on an 18-month clean reauthorization of Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA), after a bloc of conservative members refused to back renewal without privacy reforms. Section 702 lets intelligence agencies collect communications of foreigners abroad without a warrant and expires April 20 without action. The White House and Johnson both pushed for a clean extension, but conservatives, including Reps. Lauren Boebert and Anna Paulina Luna threatened to tank the vote unless a [warrant requirement](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2OwyAUhE8DHRE_NjgFxTbusu2W1gs8BxRsEJBYe_uVc4TtRprRJ33zc1tuEFPcH9-woa19XXz2yxobVNzxgNRCPnw-9idskGCRXGrGByb0UmpuBV1fBPXWOw_CUbTCGK0mwQdBg4WRC37H4S6uTgk9GZB-RW0mBasf_UijPYF8EFoqwdX14pwyk9POXQU3sAIZOCSs_VKxvO4pOtg7tOeaq8OLyxtNNvReGlFfRM5Ezj1giCmdHZFzyNup0T7x1ZDIeZyUlJNmpyMzXLJWflnJB9bG3rmfE1qtL0dMKTZtyMAfG8QPkfZ_X_S28i8AAP__KTt4UQ) to surveil Americans was added. With the deadline four days out, [Republican leadership](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHupCAYxJ8GOw18sqAFxTV2e-2V5lv4VG5RCLDL61-8R_h3k8xkZvL781yf6IO_9t94ksl1W1106-YLZrqoYShHbC62640nBlyBg-q57IVaU44lka2r6Jxx1qGwHRmhtRonwaXoDgN6JtASXnIDMU7yMSuShOhm-VIbjJ03dyGXQsEo-DgP1o56ssraWXCNGzLJMVCuQ6b0eQVv8apY3lvMlgYbzy6Yo9ZU2PiLwcJgaa0NKQZfvY13gMES_Jf6T3JYqTBY7kUGC5cMFnErG689U7m9v_G4Srz6G0C_x9TX_DlTz_mkH5pPXTYuNR-CL0ozyfcTffh_o_6Y3dfAvwAAAP__YWt_hg) is now weighing a narrow warrant-related amendment as a possible compromise. A deal must materialize by Sunday, or the surveillance authority lapses entirely.
* * *
Kamala Hints at 2028 Run

Two-time failed presidential candidate [Kamala Harris](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDGO6yAUAE9jd1iAHRsXFL9xl99uab3AI34KBgQkbG6_yh5h65FGo_m67lcgT-H-H07UubrdRrs7KpAxYANfjthsbOEBJ3jYJZcz4xMT855yLAlN3UVvtTUWhOlRi2WZRyX4JPpDCwAl5OKUAjEZuI0Cx9XdLtNqLk7Nsif9EfJJzHIUfFwHY8ZFmdmYVfAFHHQTB4-5DhnT8-bJQKhQHi5mg4OJZ-_1UWsq3fivk1snt9ba4OJ3wFY-vJNbip4qmdLJ7YCcqbBSYyrsgW-WMhayGCqBZynTCfnNSoWKzCO8KNyZjTGzRhZZTBiY5FKx_Ax91jY18p7KvHQTv59A_reo_nnjS8ufAAAA___u94hu) ignited 2028 buzz by scheduling a trip to the key primary state of South Carolina.

A new poll of 1,834 likely voters shows Florida's governor's race as a statistical tie--Donalds 41.2%, Jolly 40.5%--in a state Trump carried by 13 points. The Senate resumed debate on the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register to vote. Melania Lobbies for Foster Kids

First Lady Melania Trump made a [rare Capitol Hill visit](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLEO2yAURb_G3oh4gMEeGLpkS9eO1svjEaNgYwGp1b-v0k_oeHWlo6Pz67E-MOV0vH7izr72uIYS1pgaVj74wty2coVyHW_cMeOqpLJCGgF2PWtpJ1NfYQw-UECgkT04Z_UM0sC4-Ym0NIt2IYZZSTXHaCYyDhQ_F8l6GpP_AqUBqzRIvdyItJvJEi0gHUYcjMTMtd8qn59nToRHx_aOpRLfqOxj9lvvZxv0j0HdB3XH8-Crfa_vqD1R5kHdd854JBS9fvZTxNI6V0FYWfwpn76JzK_UMvZUDpHx2vHNtQkJKsISYF4mpyUA2GhnHXmeAI158lh9OK-Uc2rWDUa-dkz5n1b_75a_vfobAAD__5xghlo) to lobby the House Ways and Means Committee for foster care reform bills. The program hasn't been comprehensively updated since 1999.

DHS Reconciliation Plan Takes Shape

Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., is pushing a "skinny" reconciliation bill to fund Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol for three years, bypassing Democrats. The plan requires near-total GOP unity and faces [procedural hurdles](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1u4zAQBOCnkToK_NFJVsHiGnW-9kphvVxahClS4NJh_PaB06RPPcB8mPl_3a4QYkj3f3CQLdVvLrvNB4ZCiRpE3nNzuaUHHBBh01JPQo5CTdtZMp-EdVO9sw4dKOzJqnmezEXJUfW71Yv3sJjRyxsuxv0xUurRGPAXQqAF-2DfhXJUkzZKmmVANPMFJ8RFyRk8dKOESKUOhc7nLQaEVIEfPhekAfPRR7vXenJn_nZ67fTaWht8_kzU-J13ej1zDDUgd3p1Owven_U9SFCqVFg4eIlJCnoRiz0_mcQPxYKSE32x7mwhxsDT3I3yfkCI33j99WMfVn8FAAD__xBEgL8).

Peter,

I’m reaching out to you today for the very first time to ask for your personal endorsement as I run for the Republican nomination for the United States Senate in Minnesota.

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the freedoms and way of life we hold dear. As a SEAL, I learned to thrive in the toughest environments — and that same grit and determination is exactly what I’m bringing to this race.

Unlike my progressive, far-left Democrat opponents, I’m not cosplaying as a Somali Muslim to win over the votes of a leftist base who want nothing more out of the midterms than impeaching Donald Trump.

#
Hey Peter, it’s Emma from Heartland Patriots.
I’m reaching out for the first time in a while to share more about the critical mission of Heartland Patriots this cycle. **Will you please give me a moment to tell you about it?**
_It would be an understatement to say that our country is facing some serious challenges right now._ Control-obsessed politicians are relentlessly attacking our fundamental rights and freedoms. Corruption is at an all-time high. And the cost of living crisis is getting worse and worse, forcing working families to struggle to afford essentials like groceries, housing, gas, healthcare, and so much more.
**Too many of our elected leaders — at all levels of government — have been willing to sit back and watch it all happen. Or worse, willing to add fuel to the fire.** We’re seeing that on full display where I live in Missouri, as many state legislators continue trying to divide us while everyday people work harder than ever simply to make ends meet.
It’s absolutely out of control — and I bet it might feel that way where you live too.
It has never been more important to unite behind candidates across the Heartland who are dedicated to holding the line and fighting back. And that’s why I’m reaching out to tell you more about Heartland Patriots today.
**Heartland Patriots is committed to supporting candidates who will boldly stand up to the spineless politicians + corrupt elites wreaking havoc on and robbing our country.** These are candidates who are working tirelessly to protect our fundamental rights, restore our hard-fought freedoms, and actually make lives better for real working people in communities like mine and yours.
That’s where _you_ come in, Peter. With your help, we can leverage our record-setting grassroots movement to help candidates compete and win tough races across the country.
**That’s why I’m asking:[Will you chip in $10, $25, or just whatever you can to Heartland Patriots today? name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I just reintroduced the Trans Bill of Rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260416-6143-footer&t=1001&akid=6143%2E420207%2ES9ltPu ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

I want you to hear this directly from me.

I just recently reintroduced the Trans Bill of Rights in Congress.

At a time when trans people are under coordinated attack in statehouses,
in schools, in hospitals, and in public life, we are putting forward a
clear federal vision rooted in dignity, safety, and equal protection under
the law.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260416-2.Np_tCj&refcode=em20260416-6143&t=1002&akid=6143%2E420207%2ES9ltPu ]Will you split a contribution today between my campaign and Christopher
Street Project to help us build the momentum needed to pass the Trans Bill
of Rights?

This legislation affirms what should never be up for debate: that trans
and nonbinary people deserve equal protection, access to care, freedom
from discrimination, and the right to live openly without fear.

And Christopher Street Project has been organizing, mobilizing, and
building pressure to move this bill forward. That means locking in
co-sponsors, defending against bad-faith attacks, and making sure trans
voices are centered every step of the way.

Let’s be honest about what we are up against. Extreme politicians are
trying to push trans people out of public life entirely. They are flooding
the courts, rewriting laws, and testing how far they can go.

We cannot meet that with silence. We meet it with power.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260416-2.Np_tCj&refcode=em20260416-6143&t=1003&akid=6143%2E420207%2ES9ltPu ]Peter, will
you split a donation right now between my campaign and Christopher Street
Project to help us push the Trans Bill of Rights forward?

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260416-2.Np_tCj&amount=3&refcode=em20260416-6143&t=1022&akid=6143%2E420207%2ES9ltPu ]Contribute $3

Thank you,

Pramila Jayapal
Congresswoman for WA-07

That’s why this summer, we’re launching our **largest Democracy Summer class yet** , hiring and training the next generation of organizers to register voters, build community, and take on extremism head-on across Central Florida. I’m working on my list of priorities for the months leading up to the election, Derek. One top priority is clear: making sure the 2026 election is free and fair. This team has always put making the cost of living affordable and protecting our democracy at the top of the list. And while the Trump admin works to pass the dangerous SAVE Act and investigate the 2020 election _yet again_ , I am working to protect the integrity of our elections. Beyond that, I want to know what’s on your mind. While I fight to make the economy work for everyone, to confront Trump’s corruption, to hold his administration accountable, and to flip the Senate, I remain committed to standing up for you and representing your interests. To do that as effectively as I can, I want to hear about your top priorities. Since I can’t meet every member of this team in person, emails like this are the best way to ensure I understand the issues that matter most to you. _**[If you have a moment, please fill out our latest Priorities Survey and share your thoughts.
